categories.title: Divine Beast
categories.info: Divine Beasts are large animals-shaped dungeons, and are part of Breath of the Wild's main quest.

categories.title: Goddess Statue
categories.info: Goddess Statues can be gifted 4 Spirit Orbs in exchange for either a Stamina Vessel or a Heart Container.

categories.title: Great Fairy
categories.info: Great Fairies require a one-time cost to unlock, after which they can enhance Link's equipment.
categories.template:
**For the first Great Fairy:**
- Costs 100 Rupees
- Enhances up to ★

**For the second Great Fairy:**
- Costs 500 Rupees
- Enhances up to ★★

**For the third Great Fairy:**
- Costs 1,000 Rupees
- Enhances up to ★★★

**For the fourth Great Fairy:**
- Costs 10,000 Rupees
- Enhances up to ★★★★

categories.title: Landmark
categories.info: Locations are various places within Hyrule. To obtain 100% completion, Link must visit some of them, as indicated.

categories.title: Raft
categories.info: Rafts allow Link to cross bodies of water without swimming, conserving stamina and avoiding harmful effects.
categories.template: **How to use:** Swing a Korok Leaf at the sail to generate wind and move the raft. Hold your attack for a greater burst of wind.

categories.title: Sheikah Tower
categories.info: Sheikah Towers can be activated by climbing them. Once active, they reveal their associated region on Link's map.

categories.title: Shrine
categories.info: Shrines are small dungeons scattered through Hyrule. Completing one unlocks a Fast Travel point and grants a Spirit Orb.

categories.title: Village
categories.info: Villages regroup a lot of NPCs, shops and inns.

categories.title: Armor Shop
categories.info: Armor Stores sell a variety of clothing and armor. They restock after spending at least 24 hours in a different region.

categories.title: Dye Shop
categories.info: The Dye Shop will dye all of Link's currently worn clothes, at the price of 20 Rupees and 5 valid ingredients for the chosen color.

categories.title: Fang and Bone
categories.info: After meeting [Kilton](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247441), Fang and Bone become available. Only open at night, this shop requires trading monster parts for Mon, which can then be used to purchase gear. See Kilton for other locations.

categories.title: General Store
categories.info: General Stores sell a variety of materials and goods. They restock after spending at least 24 hours in a different region (except for arrows, which only restock if you have less than 50 of that type).

categories.title: Hestu
categories.info: After completing [The Priceless Maracas](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247174), Hestu will expand Link's weapon, bow and shield inventory in exchange for Korok Seeds.
categories.template:
**Location:** ??  
**Expansions:**
_Weapon Stash:_ Can be expanded 11 times, for a maximum of 19 slots.  
_Costs:_ 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 12, 17, 25, 35, 45, 55

_Bow Stash:_ Can be expanded 8 times, for a maximum of 13 slots.  
_Costs:_ 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 12, 17, 25

_Shield Stash:_ Can be expanded 16 times, for a maximum of 20 slots.  
_Costs:_ 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 15, 15, 15, 15, 15, 20

categories.title: Inn
categories.info: Inns allow Link to rest, recovering his Health. Most inns offer different sleep alternatives, granting additional bonuses.

categories.title: Jewelry Shop
categories.info: Jewelry Shops sell gem-based headgear.

categories.title: Mini-Game
categories.info: Mini-Games are repeatable challenges, which Link can undertake for prizes. The better his performance, the better the prize.

categories.title: Stable
categories.info:
All stables offer the following services:
- Horse registration - costs 20 Rupees, up to 5 registered horses. A registered horse can be whistled, tracked on the map, given a name and is given a bride and saddle to ride on.
- Rest - 20 Rupees for a regular bed, or 40 Rupees for a soft bed (grants 1 Temporary Heart)
- Merchants; see the description for the specific merchants available.

categories.title: Korok Seed
categories.info: Korok Seeds are hidden everywhere through Hyrule. After completing [The Priceless Maracas](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247174), bring Korok Seeds to [Hestu](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247173) to expand Link's inventory.

categories.title: Armor
categories.info: Equipment can be bought in shops or looted from chests. It can be upgraded at Great Fairies for greater armor bonuses. If part of a set, it also grants a set bonus once every piece is at least ★★.

categories.title: Arrow Chest
categories.info: Arrow Chests contain normal and elemental ammunition for Link's bows.

categories.title: Gem
categories.info: Gems are valuable materials mostly found in Ores. They can be sold for a high price or used to enhance armor.

categories.title: Shield
categories.info: Shields can be found in chests or dropped by enemies. They can be used a number of times equal to their Durability before breaking. Depending on Link's progress, a shield found in a chest may have modifiers or be scaled to a higher tier in its series.

categories.title: Weapon
categories.info: Weapons can be found in chests or dropped by enemies. They can be used a number of times equal to their Durability before breaking. Depending on Link's progress, a weapon found in a chest may have modifiers or be scaled to a higher tier in its series.

categories.title: Main Quest
categories.info: Main Quests are the way to completing the game

categories.title: Memory
categories.info: Memories appear after starting the [Captured Memories](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248310) Main Quest. Interact with the glowing light.

categories.info: Completing a Shrine Quest unlocks it's associated Shrine.

categories.title: Side Quest
categories.info: Side Quests are optional quests given by various inhabitants of Hyrule. Complete them for a variety of rewards.

categories.title: Enemy Camp
categories.info: Enemy camps contain a set number of enemies; defeat them all to unlock the chest. An [S] tag means that enemy scales with Link's progression.

categories.title: Guardian
categories.info: Guardians are mechanical enemies, commonly found within Shrines and Divine Beasts.

categories.title: Journal
categories.info: Journals can be read by Link to provide a wide variety of information, such as lore, recipes or hints towards quests.

categories.title: Unique Horse
categories.info: Unique horses are only capturable during their respective quest. They can thereafter be registered as normal horses.

categories.title: Zora Monument
categories.info: Zora Monuments tell the story of the Zora, and are part of the [Zora Stone Monuments](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247253) side quest.

locations.title: Divine Beast Vah Ruta
locations.description:
**Related quest:** [Divine Beast Vah Ruta](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248591)  
**Contents:**
- **Ancient Spring:** 1st terminal room - In a chest, at the bottom of the right water bassin.
- **Silver Rupee:** 2nd terminal room - Ride the water wheel to the top, then paraglide to the ledge where the water comes from.
- **Ancient Core:** 3rd terminal room - As the giant wheel rotates, Stasis the stone slab above the chest. Open it before the Stasis runs out.
- **[Fire Arrow x10](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246021):** 3rd terminal room - One of the blades of the water wheel is covered in Malice; shoot the eye underneath to access the chest on top.
- **Ancient Shaft:** Trunk - From the 3rd terminal room, lower the trunk and paraglide to the end.
- **[Ice Arrow x10](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246022):** Top of Ruta - Ride the trunk to its highest point, and shoot the eye to the right to free the chest to the left.

Once completed, moves [here](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246015).

locations.title: Divine Beast Vah Naboris
locations.description:
**Related quest:** [Divine Beast Vah Naboris](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248651)  
**Contents:**
- **Ancient Core:**: Rear - In a chest, suspended by a rope. Stasis the chest, shoot the rope and Magnesis before it falls down.
- **Ancient Shaft:** Middle cylinder - Shoot the eye to get rid of the Malice. Then, rotate the cylinder and paraglide to it.
- **[Knight's Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246017)**: Middle cylinder - Opposite of the chest above; rotate the cylinder twice to access.
- **[Bomb Arrow x5](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246018)**: Back left leg - Access from the ramp outside.
- **Ancient Spring:** Front right leg - Bomb the cracked window from the inside.
- **[Knight's Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246019)**: Neck - Paraglide to the grated passageway up top. Then, rotate the cylinders to close the circuit at the top and open the grate. The chest is at the end of the trapped hallway.
- **Topaz:** Back hump - At the top; access by climbing the front hump and taking the moving platform.

Moves [here](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246020) once completed.

locations.title: Divine Beast Vah Medoh
locations.description:
**Related quest:** [Divine Beast Vah Medoh](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248323)  
**Contents:**
- **Sapphire:** End of the head - Shoot the eye just right of the chest to clear the path.
- **Ancient Core:** Stomach - On top of a pillar. First, use Stasis to move the platorm left. Then, use Magnesis to bring the metal platform down. Finally, Stasis the moving platform again; the metal platform will block it and grant Link access.
- **[Bomb Arrow x5](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246024):** Back right leg - On a platform, halfway up the beast. Drop down from the Guiding Stone room.
- **Ancient Shaft:** Rear - On the lower level, hidden by Malice. Shoot the eye to reveal the chest.
- **[Ice Arrow x10](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246025):** Left wing - Stuck on the ceiling with Malice; shoot the eye to release it.
- **[Knight's Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246026):** Left wing - On a tall platform. Tilt the Divine Beast right, then paraglide from the end of the wing.
- **[Knight's Claymore](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246027):** Right wing - On a platform, at the end of the wing. Tilt the Divine Beast right, then paraglide from the Ancient Core platform to access.
- **Giant Ancient Core:** End of the tail - Paraglide from the updrafts outside to access.

Moves [here](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246028) once completed.

locations.title: Divine Beast Vah Rudania
locations.description:
**Related quest:** [Divine Beast Vah Rudania](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248313)  
**Contents:**
- **[Dragonbone Boko Club](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246030):** Lower abdomen, left side - Covered in Malice; shoot the eye to reveal it.
- **[Torch](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246031):** Lower abdomen, right side - Covered in Malice; shoot the eye to reveal it.
- **[Ice Arrow x5](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246032):** Lower abdomen - Stuck to the ceiling with Malice; shoot the eye to dislodge it.
- **[Knight's Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246033):** Upper abdomen, left side - Stuck to the wall with Malice; shoot the eye to dislodge it.
- **[Arrow x5](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246035):** Upper abdomen, right side - Stuck to the wall with Malice; shoot the eye to dislodge it.
- **[Arrow x5](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246036):** Upper abdomen, right side - Stuck to the wall with Malice; shoot the eye to dislodge it.
- **Ancient Core:** Spine - Start on the right side of the torso. Tilt the Divine Beast left, then exit through the small opening and make your way towards the center.
- **[Knight's Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246034):** Upper abdomen - On top of a horizontal pillar; access by paragliding from the top.
- **Ancient Gear:** Lower abdomen, right side - Stuck to the ceiling in the terminal room. Shoot a Fire Arrow at the leaves to dislodge it.
- **Silver Rupee:** Underside - Start outside, by the head. Tilt the Divine Beast left to notice a Malice-covered platform. Drop down and jump in the opening to access.

locations.title: Divine Beast Vah Rudania
locations.description:
**Requirements:** [Seek Out Impa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248305)  
**Steps:**
1. Bludo, Boss of Goron City, wants to challenge the marauding Divine Beast Vah Rudania, but his backache is too severe.  
What's worse, Yunobo has yet to return from the [Abandoned North Mine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246308) with the painkillers he was sent to fetch.
2. You met Drak in the Abandoned North Mine, who told you that Yunobo left for the vault deep in its reaches. That's the last anyone has seen of Yunobo...  
Mount a search operation for Yunobo, who was headed for the [vault](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248315).
3. You met Yunobo in the Abandoned North Mine.  
Yunobo hurried back to Goron City to deliver the painkillers Bludo needs for his backache.  
You should go speak to [Bludo](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248312) to collect your reward.
4. Bludo thanked you for helping Yunobo. After taking the painkillers, Bludo was about to go challenge Divine Beast Vah Rudania, but then his back started hurting again. No one will be challenging the Divine Beast today, it seems.  
[Yunobo](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248318) has already gone ahead to the Bridge of Eldin, so you must meet him there to let him know about this change of plans.
5. You helped Yunobo fend off monsters at the Bridge of Eldin before telling him that Bludo's plan had been called off.  
You still need to get inside the Divine Beast somehow, though... The best way forward may be to [lower the Bridge of Eldin](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248319).
6. Yunobo used Daruk's Protection to act as a cannonball. The Bridge of Eldin has been lowered!  
All you need to do now is to cross the Bridge of Eldin and drive Divine Beast Vah Rudania into the crater.
7. Sentries now patrol Death Mountain to eliminate intruders.  
Avoid their notice as you lead Yunobo to the cannons to drive [Divine Beast Vah Rudania](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246029) into the crater.
8. Defeating Fireblight Ganon freed the spirit of Daruk, Champion of the Goron race. He has piloted the Divine Beast to the summit of Death Mountain in preparation for the assault on Ganon.  
Seeing this, a relieved Yunobo returned to his home in Goron City. You should go there and tell Bludo all that has happened.

**Next quest:** [Free the Divine Beasts](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248311)

locations.title: Tho Kayu Shrine
locations.description:
## Tho Kayu's Blessing

**Location:** Hidden in the ground; reveal it by lighting all 4 torches around the shrine, on the stone structures.  
**Solution:**
1. Walk to the monk to complete the trial.

**Treasure:**
1. [Golden Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246907) - In the middle of the room.

locations.title: Bareeda Naag Shrine
locations.description:
## Cannon

**Location:** ??  
**Shrine quest:** [The Ancient Rito Song](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247032)  
**Solution:**
1. Climb the ladder near the butt of the cannon, drop a Round Bomb in it and detonate it. Doing so will fire a cannon ball on a wooden plank, which will break and reveal the goal.
2. Repeat the process, this time aiming the detonation so the cannon ball hits the goal without touching the moving targets.
3. Walk through the gate to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Swallow Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247033) - Behind a wall of cracked blocks, just right of the entrance.
2. [Diamond](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247034) - Past the monk room, there is a second cannon. Repeat the walkthrough above to unlock a room with the chest.

locations.title: Voo Lota Shrine
locations.description:
## The Winding Route

**Location:** ??  
**Shrine quest:** [Recital at Warbler's Nest](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247041)  
**Solution:**
1. Climb the ladder, and walk to the switch.
2. Hit the switch, and immediately paraglide to Treasure Chest #1.
3. Glide along the air currents, stopping before the spiked walls, up to the locked monk.
4. Continue left of the monk, gliding along the air currents and riding the upwards fan. Continue gliding up to the chest with the Small Key.
5. Circle back to the monk the air currents, and unlock the door to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Flameblade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247046) - Face right as you hit the switch; you should see the chest on a lonely pillar to the right.

2. Walk through the gate to complete the shrine.

locations.title: Sho Dantu Shrine
locations.description:
## Two Bombs

**Location:** Hidden in the ground; place a Luminous Stone on the pedestal to reveal it.  
**Solution:**
1. Blow up the boxes to the left to reveal a room.
2. Using the pillar, launch yourself in the air and land on the cage.
3. Drop a bomb on top of the cage, then drop down and detonate it. Doing so will open a room on the right side.
4. In the right room, place a bomb next to the switch behind the pillar. Then, climb on the lowered pillar.
5. Blow up the bomb to launch yourself in the air. Land on the cage, drop a bomb, drop down and detonate it. Doing so will open the far room.
6. Throw a Round Bomb in either launcher, then walk back to either pillar near the entrance to the room.
7. Detonate the bomb when as it flies above the cage to trigger the switch and complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Silver Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246926) - Behind the far column, in the left room.

locations.title: Mezza Lo Shrine
locations.description:
## Ancient Trifecta

**Location:** ??  
**Shrine quest:** [The Crowned Beast](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246621)  
**Solution:**
1. Walk right, up the ramp towards the orange crystal. Drop a square bomb.
2. Hit the crystal until the pillar is near Link's platform. Step on the pillar.
3. Magnesis the metal block; doing so will rotate the platform. Drop the block on the lower floor.
4. Shoot the crystal to rotate it once more. Alternatively, Stasis the laser, since it will hit the crystal when it breaks out.
5. Magnesis the metal block on the pressure plate.
6. Step back on the pillar and detonate the bomb. This should rotate the pillar in front of the now open door.
7. Step through the door to complete the trial.

**Treasure:**
1. [Thunderblade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246622) - On a platform, to the left of the room. Link should be on this platform after step 3 of the above solution.

locations.title: Kam Urog Shrine
locations.description:
## Trial of Passage

**Location:** ??  
**Shrine quest:** [The Cursed Statue](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246635)  
**Solution:**
1. Move to the center of the wheel, in the way of the giant rotating blades. Move any spiked ball in the way with Magnesis.
2. Get 'scooped' by the blade, climbing on it when it gets horizontal enough.
3. Jump to the central gear, and wait for a blade to come down on the right side.
4. When the blade is horizontal, jump on it and run to the platform with the lamp post.
5. Jump on the gear to the next platform.
6. Wait for the smaller blade, which ends in a staircase, to come to the top. When it does, run on the staircase to complete the trial.

**Treasure:**
1. [Opal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246637) - On a ledge, halfway up the wheel. Get on the blade and paraglide to the ledge once Link is high enough.
2. [Soldier's Spear](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246636) - On the back of one of the rotating blades. From the Opal above, wait until that blade is down and paraglide to it.

locations.title: Maka Rah Shrine
locations.description:
## Steady Thy Heart

**Location:** In the mountain; access from a hole in the northeastern cliffside.  Blow up the stone mounds to reveal a series of updrafts.
**Solution:**
1. Light the torch on the left side of the door to open it.
2. Make your way across the rotating cylinder and step on the pressure plate.
3. Defeat all four Guardian Scouts.
4. Cryonis a pillar in front of the left-most pillar, then climb on it and step on the pressure plate to open the door.
5. Step on the pressure plate to lift the bars. Then, while hugging the left wall, move towards the boxed until the spiked ball rolls past.
6. Walk right and step on the pressure plate; doing so will lift the bars and release a spiked ball. Magnesis the ball on its way down.
7. Put the ball aside, Stasis it, then run up the ramp to the monk to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Bomb Arrow x10](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247080) - On the right-most pillar, in the guardian room. Cryonis a pillar in front of it to access.
2. [Diamond](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247079) - Behind cracked blocks, atop the ramp with the spiked ball. Once at the top, turn around and blow the blocks, then Magnesis the chest.
3. [Ancient Core](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247078) - In an alcove, in the wall beyond the lava. Grab it using Magnesis.

locations.title: Kah Okeo Shrine
locations.description:
## Wind Guide

**Location:** Under a stone slab; Stasis it, then hit it away to reveal the shrine.  
**Solution:**
1. Grab the [Korok Leaf](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247048) from the chest left.
2. Using the Korok Leaf, blow wind on the turbine to open the door.
3. Drop down and defeat the three sword-wielding Guardians, then climb back up.
4. Activate the turbine to spawn a floating platform. To control it, step on it and blow wind in the desired direction. Move to the back ledge. 
5. Follow the path to the Guardian Scout I and defeat it. Then, blow up the cracked block behind.
6. Step on the launch pillar, and activate the turbine to launch Link into the air. Paraglide right to the structure.
7. In the structure, blow up the cracked block to reveal an air draft; ride it to the higher ledge.
8. Activate the turbine to spawn a floating platform. Guide it through the spiked blocks maze to the ledge.
9. Stand on the launch pillar and activate the turbine to launch Link on the higher platform.
10. Activate the turbine in the room to the left to spawn a floating explosive barrel. Guide it to one of the torches around the tall pillar to blow up the stone blocks and reveal an air draft.
11. Paraglide to the pillar, ride the air draft to the top and open the chest for the Small Key.
12. Paraglide to the archway flanked by blue torches.
13. Drop down and unlock the door to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Gold Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247047) - On a pillar, in the back of the sword-wielding guardians room. After spawning the platform, guide it towards the back.
2. [Forest Dweller's Sword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247050) - On a high platform, in the launch pillar room. After launching Link, paraglide left to the chest.
3. [Giant Ancient Core](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247049) - On a ledge, high near the second floating platform. Guide it right to the chest.
4. [Thunderspear](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247051) - In the final room before the monk. When you drop down, paraglide to the top left corner on the ledge.

locations.title: Hawa Koth Shrine
locations.description:
## The Current Solution

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Magnesis the metal blocks on each side of the black pillars, so they connect through their corners.
2. Magnesis the chained orb near the switch against the left wall to activate the elevator.
3. Defeat the Guardian Scouts guarding the bridge.
4. Magnesis the unchained orb across the bridge and on the pedestal on the left side. Be careful to avoid the switches on the bridge itself.
5. Reconnect the circuit:
    - Step on the pressure plate to send the blocks back;
    - Magnesis the metal block to the right side, in front of the 3rd block;
    - Step off the pressure plate, sending the first 2 blocks back in front;
    - Magnesis the metal block against the 2nd block _while_ stepping on the pressure plate, sending the 1st block back. The 2nd block should split in two;
    - Finally, release the Magnesis and step on the plate. Then, when the hole is aligned, Magnesis the block left;
6. Magnesis the large gear in the now open room to the locked monk room to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Sapphire](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246902) - In the gear room.
2. [Gold Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246903) - In a secret alcove to the right of the bridge. Near the end, Magnesis the unchained orb on the high ledge to open the metal door leading to the chest.
3. [Ancient Core](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246904) - In the water pool, on the right side. Grab it with Magnesis.

## Melting Ice Hazard

**Location:** Encased in ice; melt it with fire to access.  
**Solution:**
1. Pick up an ice cube; it must be carried all the way to the monk.
2. Walk around the first few fire pillars.
3. Throw the ice cube before the horizontal pillars, so it slides under them.
4. Jump on the sumberged metal block on the next platform.
5. Magnesis the metal block to block the fire pillars.
6. Throw the ice cube past the fire pillars, then Magnesis the block on the pillars. Make sure the fire stopped before walking under the cube.
7. Offer the ice to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Frostblade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246923) - In a column, behind fire pillars. After crossing the first horizontal fire pillars, Magnesis the metal block on the pillars to block them. Paraglide from up the ramp to access the chest.

**Solution:**
1. Walk up the staircase, then turn right.
2. Defeat the [Guardian Scout I](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246881) and navigate the tight corridors.
3. Cross the gap on the moving platform, and Magnesis the power source. Hold it against the wire to cross the gap again.
4. Move up the ramp and power the elevator to the top.
5. Drop the power source in the middle of the room to destroy both Guardian Scouts.
6. Magnesis the metal block away.
7. Magnesis the power source past the metal block, on the upwards ramp, on the elevator and drop it on the pedestal.
8. Wait for the moving platform, then ride it to the monk to complete the shrine. Magnesis the metal block forward to clear the path.

**Treasure:**
1. [Moonlight Scimitar](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246887) - When taking the first elevator, remove the power source halfway up. The chest is in a small alcove.
2. [Ancient Core](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246885) - In the room with two Guardian Scouts; drop down, and turn around. The chest is against the wall.
3. [Silver Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246884) - Past the first metal block, take the ramp down and hit the switch to activate the elevator. Ride it all the way down.
4. [Radiant Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246886) - At the end of the shrine, behind the metal block. When the platform is at the monk, Magnesis the block backwards. Jump to the chest as the platform goes back.

locations.title: Daqo Chisay Shrine
locations.description:
## The Whole Picture

**Location:** Just outside the North Entrance to Gerudo Town  
**Solution:** Follow the linked walkthrough for the solution and Treasure chest.  
**Treasure:**
1. [Thunderblade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246891) - See walkthrough.

locations.title: Rok Uwog Shrine
locations.description:
## Power of Reach

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Grab Treasure Chest #1.
2. Shoot an arrow through the torch just left of the entrance to burn away the leaves and reveal a passage.
3. Defeat the [Guardian Scout II](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247076).
4. Magnesis the metal block to drop the ramp.
5. Cross to the other side and defeat the other [Guardian Scout II](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247077).
6. Using the Drillshaft, destroy the barrels on the pressure plate to open the door and grab the Small Key.
7. Return near the entrance and open the locked door to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Drillshaft](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247075) - On ledge, directly in front of the entrance. Grab it using Magnesis.

locations.title: Gee Ha'rah Shrine
locations.description:
## Tandem

**Location:** Behind a stone door, at the base of the mountain. Pick up a [Snowball](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247089) and throw it down the left-most groove; the snowball should grow and roll down to the door.  
**Solution:**
1. Shoot the arrow supporting the boulder to push the piston and unlock the door.
2. At the crossroads, turn right into the next room. Stasis the boulder, then shoot both ropes so the boulder falls straight on the piston.
3. Walk through the gate to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Diamond](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247090) - At the crossroads, turn left to see the chest beyond a barred room. Shoot the left rope supporting the boulder, so it falls on the piston and opens the door.

locations.title: Goma Asaagh Shrine
locations.description:
## A Major Test of Strength

**Location:** Against the western side of the mountain, hidden behind ice pillars. Melt them to access the shrine.  
**Solution:**
1. Defeat the [Guardian Scout IV](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247070).
2. Step through the gate to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Royal Claymore](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247071) - Just past the gate.

locations.title: Lanno Kooh Shrine
locations.description:
## Lanno Kooh's Blessing

**Location:** Under the mountain; swim from the river flowing from [Hebra Falls](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246114) to access. Cryonis pillars as soon as possible to avoid freezing.  
**Solution:**
1. Walk to the monk to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Gold Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247086) - In the middle of the room.

locations.title: Dunba Taag Shrine
locations.description:
## Build and Release

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Stasis the rotating gear when the platform is horizontal so the ball rolls on it and pushes the piston.
2. Move to the far right corner of the next room.
3. Stasis the stone slab, then build momentum away (either by shooting arrows or throwing bombs). The slab should wall on the pressure plate and open the room beyond.
4. Walk in the room to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Falcon Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247088) - In the 2nd room, in a barred room left of the entrance. Blow up the stone blocks to reveal a hidden piston. Move in front of it, then turn around to see 4 barrels. Bring one to the edge, Stasis it and build momentum towards the piston. When done right, the barrel will press the piston and unlock the room.
2. [Great Thunderblade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247087) - In a barred room, in the far left corner of the 2nd room. Push the nearby boulder towards the ramp, Stasis it a build a little momentum towards the door. The boulder should cross the bump and press the pressure plate, unlocking the room.

locations.title: Shae Loya Shrine
locations.description:
## Aim for the Moment

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Stasis the bouncing ball when it reaches its apex. While in Stasis, fire a few arrows at it to build momentum.
2. Wait for the ball to drop in the goal and activate the launch pillar. Step on it.
3. Shoot at the switch, in an alcove high in the far wall, to open the gate and complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Topaz](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247018) - On a ledge, behind the bouncing ball. Paraglide to it from the launch pillar.
2. [Falcon Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247019) - On a wooden platform against the back wall. Use the launch pillar to rise and shoot the ropes supporting the platform to drop the chest.

locations.title: Mogg Latan Shrine
locations.description:
## Synced Swing

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Jump on the moving swing to the next platform.
2. Magnesis the inert swing away, then release it go get it moving. Jump to the next platform.
3. Shoot the ropes to lower the bridge.
4. One by one, Magnesis the spiked ball while walking past them.
5. Magnesis the sliding block close to Link, then jump on it before it slides back.
6. Magnesis the 4 sliding blocks to create a staircase.
7. Hit the switch to drop two lanterns. Magnesis one of them so it swings horizontally. When it's above the leaves, Stasis it and shoot the rope; it should drop on the leaves and burn them.
    - Alternatively, shoot the leaves with a Fire Arrow.
8. Magnesis the door to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Forest Dweller's Spear](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247027) - Past the bridge, on a narrow ledge to the right.
2. [Forest Dweller's Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247026) - Behind a 4th spiked ball, behind the first three. Use the same method as described above.
3. [Gold Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247025) - Behind the sliding blocks, on a low platform. When creating the staircase, leave the top block away, then climb and paraglide to the chest.

locations.title: Kay Noh Shrine
locations.description:
## Power of Electricity

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Magnesis the green orb on the empty pedestal.
2. At the crossroads, turn right and defeat the [Guardian Scout I](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246875). Then, shoot the rope holding the orb.
3. Magnesis the green orb on the empty pedestal to the left.
4. Wait for the block to fall and open the chest past the staircase to obtain the Small Key.
5. Return to the crossroads and open the door in the center.
6. Defeat the [Guardian Scout II](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246876).
7. Magnesis the metal block in the right pool to connect the electricity to complete the shrine. Use the left pool for reference.

**Treasure:**
1. [Gerudo Scimitar](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246877) - On a ledge, above the entrance to the final room. Grab it using Magnesis.

locations.title: Misae Suma Shrine
locations.description:
## Misae Suma's Blessing
**Shrine quest:** [The Perfect Drink](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246918)

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Walk to the monk to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Diamond](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246922) - In the middle of the room.

locations.title: Sha Gehma Shrine
locations.description:
## Shift and Lock

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Magnesis the sliding metal block while climbing the spiraling ramp to rise it in the air, just past the moving platforms.
2. Drop the Magnesis on the moving platforms. Then, Stasis the block, and quickly drop down on the central platform and get the Small Key from the chest before the Stasis runs out.
3. Unlock the door against the far wall to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Royal Broadsword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247069) - On a pillar, near the spiraling ramp. Paraglide to it from a higher ledge.

locations.title: Rona Kachta Shrine
locations.description:
## Rona Kachta's Blessing

**Location:** At the end of the [Forgotten Temple](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246146).  
**Solution:**
1. Walk to the monk to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Great Flameblade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247099) - In the middle of the room.

locations.title: Rin Oyaa Shrine
locations.description:
## Directing the Wind

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Magnesis both metal cubes in front of the fans coming out of the central pillar.
2. Pick up the orb, and move to the top of the ramp, on the runed floor.
3. Drop the orb down; it should roll down the ramp, move along the edges of the room following the air currents and into the goal, lifting Link up.
4. Walk to the monk to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Ancient Core](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247085) - On the 2nd level, on a pillar. Once the ball has passed the first blocked fan, Magnesis the metal cube blocking it to the 2nd level. Once Link is up, Magnesis the block in the gap and jump to the chest.

locations.title: Monya Toma Shrine
locations.description:
## Drawing Parabolas

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Walk to the nearby launcher to launch Link to the 2nd launcher. Repeat to the 3rd launcher.
2. Hit the switch 3 times, so the 3rd launcher faces the goal.
3. Blow up the wooden crates beyond the 3rd launcher to clear the way.
4. Grab the orb near the entrance and drop it into the 1st launcher. The orb should fly from launcher to launcher and into the goal.
5. Walk through the gate to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Thunderblade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247095) - On a high ledge, on the third launcher. Hit the switch so the chest faces the 2nd launcher, then launch Link twice and paraglide to the chest.

locations.title: Maag No'rah Shrine
locations.description:
## Maag No'rah's Blessing

**Location:** Inside the mountain; access from a cracked wall in the northern cliffside.  
**Solution:**
1. Walk to the monk to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Silver Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247020) - In the middle of the room.

locations.title: Zalta Wa Shrine
locations.description:
## Two Orbs to Guide You

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Shoot an arrow at the orb on the pedestal to the right. If needed, grab it and place it in the pedestal.
2. Grab the orb from the now open small room in the center.
3. Step on the pressure plate to the left, and throw the orb in the now-open small room.
4. As the bridge extends, hit the switch to launch Link in the air and on the bridge.
5. Climb the ramp to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Knight's Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247006) - On top of the small room on the left. Paraglide from the staircase past the moving bridge.

locations.title: Rota Ooh Shrine
locations.description:
## Passing of the Gates

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Shoot the switch to rotate the structure.
2. Walk on the metal walkway to the left of the structure, and grab the Small Key in the chest.
3. Shoot the switch again to rotate the structure.
4. Unlock the door and grab the orb behind it. Throw the orb in the metal basket to the right of the structure.
5. Shoot the switch to rotate the structure; the orb should activate the launcher in the center. Stand on it.
6. As Link rises in the air, shoot the switch one last time to rotate the structure. Land on it to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Feathered Edge](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246985) - On a high ledge, against the back wall. When launching in the air, face the back wall, and paraglide to the chest.

locations.title: Dah Kaso Shrine
locations.description:
## A Minor Test of Strength

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Defeat the [Guardian Scout II](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246998)
2. Step through the gate to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Ancient Core](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246997) - Just past the gate.

locations.title: Keh Namut Shrine
locations.description:
## Cryonis Trial

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Interact with the terminal on the left ot receive the Cryonis rune.
2. Step in the water, then Cryonis under Link to access the ledge above.
3. Cryonis the water under the gate to raise it.
4. Defeat the [Guardian Scout I](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246596).
5. On the right, Cryonis the water on either side of the stone slab to create a ramp.
6. Climb the staircase above the hallway to complete the trial.

**Treasure:**
1. [Traveler's Spear](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246597) - In an high alcove, facing the ramp. To access, Cryonis the water in front, then climb the pillar.

locations.title: Jee Noh Shrine
locations.description:
## On the Move

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Shoot the orb off the conveyor belt into the goal behind.
2. In the next room, defeat both Guardian Scouts, then shoot the orb into the goal.
3. In the next room, grab the orb. Then, make your way across the conveyor belt, hiding behind stone blocks to avoid lasers.
4. Drop the orb into the goal to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Opal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246874) - In the third room, moving along the stone blocks conveyor belt. Stand on the platform between the two lasers and grab it using Magnesis when it comes close.

locations.title: Dila Maag Shrine
locations.description:
## Dila Maag's Blessing

**Location:** In the center of the [South Lomei Labyrinth](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246185)  
**Shrine quest:** [The Desert Labyrinth](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246905)  
**Solution:**
1. Walk to the monk to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Barbarian Armor](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246906) - In the middle of the room.

locations.title: Qaza Tokki Shrine
locations.description:
## Qaza Tokki's Shrine

**Location:** In the center of the [North Lomei Labyrinth](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246186).  
**Shrine quest:** [Trial on the Cliff](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247061)  
**Solution:**
1. Walk to the monk to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Barbarian Leg Wraps](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247062) - In the middle of the room.

locations.title: Daag Chokah Shrine
locations.description:
## Daag Shokah's Blessing

**Location:** ??  
**Shrine quest:** [The Lost Pilgrimage](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247101)  
**Solution:**
1. Walk to the monk to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Ancient Core](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247103) - In the middle of the room.

locations.title: Katah Chuki Shrine
locations.description:
## A Minor Test of Strength

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Defeat the [Guardian Scout II](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247000)
2. Step through the gate to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Royal Halberd](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247001) - Just past the gate.

locations.title: Noya Neha Shrine
locations.description:
## A Minor Test of Strength

**Location:** In the mountain; access by blowing up the cracked wall on the western cliffside, and burning away the vines.  
**Solution:**
1. Defeat the [Guardian Scout II](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246995).
2. Step through the gate to complete the trial.

**Treasure:**
1. [Knight's Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246996) - Just past the gate.

locations.title: Kaam Ya'tak Shrine
locations.description:
## Trial of Power

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Magnesis the ball in the high ramp away from the door, then release it. The boulder should open the stone door.
2. Walk past the spiky balls trap, using Magnesis to use one as a blocker if needed.
3. Turn left, and defeat the sword-wielding Guardian Scouts.
4. Shoot the rope holding the lantern to burn away the wooden ledge and release the stone boulder to open the stone door.
5. Climb the staircase and defeat the spear-wielding Guardian Scouts.
6. Stasis the seesaw in the corridor to keep it straight, then walk past it.
7. Interact with the terminal to hit the stone boulder, breaking the obstacles and eventually opening the stone door.
8. Walk through the door, down the corridor and near the torch at the end.
9. Using the torch, light an arrow and shoot the foliage to burn away the wooden platform holding the boulder.
10. Stasis the seesaw so it stays straight. Then, step on the pressure plate as the boulder reaches the end of the ramp. This should launch the boulder on the seesaw and into the door.
11. Step on the pressure plate to open the gate. Then. Stasis the stone structure in front of it, and build momentum towards to door to break it open.
12. Stand in front of the switch to hit it; this will launch Link into the air and complete the shrine.


**Treasure:**
1. [Edge of Duality](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246990) - In a chest, on the right side behind the sword-wielding Guardian Scouts.
2. [Knight's Broadsword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246989) - Past the 2nd stone door, on the left beside the staircase.
3. [Ancient Core](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246986) - Just before the 3rd stone door, on the left side.
4. [Silver Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246988) - Past the 4th stone door, behind cracked blocks on the right.
5. [Diamond](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246987) - In the final room, behind a grate. Drop down from the monk platform and go behind the column to access.

locations.title: Ja Baij Shrine
locations.description:
## Bomb Trial

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Interact with the terminal on the left to obtain the Remote Bomb runes.
2. Blow up the rocky part the middle of the wall.
3. At the crossroads, turn left and blow up the rock wall.
4. From the moving platform, throw a bomb at the rock wall.
5. Place a Round Bomb on the right-most piston, then detonate it when it reaches the other side. Repeat until the platform is cleared.
6. Drop down and climb the ladder to the now-cleared platform to complete the trial.

**Treasure:**
1. [Traveler's Claymore](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246594) - At the first crossroads, turn right instead and blow up the rock wall.
2. [Amber](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246595) - In the piston room, ride the left-most piston to the chest.

locations.title: Oman Au Shrine
locations.description:
## Magnesis Trial

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Interact with the terminal on the left to obtain the Magnesis rune.
2. Lift the metal plate in the middle of the room to reveal a hidden passageway.
3. Using Magnesis, remove the metal block from the wall and use it to destroy the rest of the wall.
4. Defeat the [Guardian Scout I](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246593); you can use Magnesis to drop the metal block on it.
5. Cross the metal bridge, then use Magnesis to move the bridge on the other side.
6. Open the metal door to complete the trial.

**Treasure:**
1. [Traveler's Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246592) - On a high ledge, left of the final metal door. Grab it using Magnesis.

locations.title: Ya Naga Shrine
locations.description:
## Shatter the Heavens

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Place a Round Bomb under the stone block, and a Square Bomb underneath.
2. Detonate the Round Bomb to launch the block in the air. Then, as the block reaches its apex, detonate the Square Bomb to blow up the cracked ceiling.
3. Place another Round Bomb under the stone block, and jump on top of it.
4. Detonate the Round Bomb to launch yourself upwards and complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Eightfold Blade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246701) - On a pillar, in the room with the monk. Face the right wall before launching into the air, then paraglide to the chest.

locations.title: Owa Daim Shrine
locations.description:
## Stasis Trial

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Interact with the terminal on the left to receive the Stasis rune.
2. Stasis the gear when the slab is horizontal to cross it.
3. Using the boulder ramp, run to the higher platform in-between two boulders.
4. Grab the [Iron Sledgehammer](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246599), lying against the left wall.
5. Stasis the boulder on the bridge, then hit it with the Iron Sledgehammer a few times. When the Stasis runs out, the boulder should fly away, clearing the bridge and completing the trial.

**Treasure:**
1. [Traveler's Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246598): On the highest platform of the boulder ramp.

locations.title: Ishto Soh Shrine
locations.description:
## Bravery's Grasp

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Drop into the main room, and pick up the Beamos against the right wall.
2. Drop the Beamos on the moving platform, facing the right wall, so it hits the switch once with each passing of the platform.
3. Go to the back wall, and use the moving platforms to rise up and complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Topaz](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246699) - In a small corridor on the right side of the room. Drop from the entrance.
2. [Ancient Core](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246700) - On a pillar, against the left wall. Once the pillars are moving, paraglide towards the wall. Adjust the timing so Link arrives when pillars are low.

locations.title: Keo Ruug Shrine
locations.description:
## Fateful Stars

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. This is an observation puzzle. On the back wall, 4 constellations are represented. For each one:
    - Count the number of times it appears on far wall.
    - In front of it, place an orb in the pedestal with the corresponding amount of torches.
2. Facing the far wall, from left to right, the answer is 5, 3, 1, 2.
3. Walk to the monk to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Knight's Claymore](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247110) - In the monk room, in a barred room in the back right corner. Above these bars is another constellation wall. Repeat the process to open the gate, the answer being 4, 2, 2, 1.

locations.title: Maag Halan Shrine
locations.description:
## Maag Halan's Blessing

**Location:** ??  
**Shrine quest:** [The Trial of Wood](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247108)  
**Solution:**
1. Walk to the monk to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**

locations.title: Kaya Wan Shrine
locations.description:
## Shields from Water

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Cryonis your way up the ledge.
2. Destroy the [Guardian Scout I](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246646), then Cryonis your way past the water pool.
3. Destroy both Guardian Scouts, then Cryonis your way up to the waterfall.
4. Paraglide to the monk to complete the trial.

**Treasure:**
1. [Ancient Core](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246645) - Floating in the second water pool. Cryonis underneath to open the chest.
2. [Knight's Broadsword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246644) - In a grated alcove, in the third water pool. From the first Guardian Scout platform, Cryonis under the grate to lift it and swim to the chest.

locations.title: Hila Rao Shrine
locations.description:
## Drifting

**Location:** In the middle of the flower field.  
**Shrine quest:** [Watch Out for the Flowers](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246604)  
**Solution:**
1. Cross the first water pool using the moving plank.
2. Cross the second water pool using the moving planks.
3. Cryonis a pillar on either side of the third water pool. From there, throw a bomb at the far wall to break it.
4. Paraglide to the opening to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Opal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246605) - At the bottom of the second water pool, just left of the ledge. Use Magnesis from a raft to pull out the chest.
2. [Ice Arrow x5](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246606) - Floating in the third water pool. Cryonis a pillar underneath, then climb it.

locations.title: Wahgo Katta Shrine
locations.description:
## Metal Connections

**Location:** On the side of the path.  
**Solution:**
1. Magnesis the stack of cubes to the right against the pillar in the far right corner of the room.
2. Climb the stacked cubes, and Magnesis the bridge down.
3. Magnesis the stack of cubes against the far wall, in the center.
4. Magnesis the bridge on top of the cubes and the pillar in the far left corner.
5. Climb the stacked cubes and cross the bridge to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**

locations.title: Bosh Kala Shrine
locations.description:
## The Wind Guides You

**Location:** At the base of the cliff, near the road.  
**Solution:**

2. Paraglide along the wind current to the central platform.
3. Walk up to the elevated platform, then paraglide along the wind current.
4. Turn left to complete the trial.

**Treasure:**
1. [Amber](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246600) - On a pillar. From the start, walk to the left platform and paraglide along the wind current to the chest.
2. [Soldier's Claymore](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246601) - In an alcove, far within the right wall of the main room. Access by paragliding from the final platform.

locations.title: Pumaag Nitae Shrine

locations.title: Ka'o Makagh Shrine
locations.description:
## Metal Doors Open the Way

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Magnesis the large metal doors open.
2. Defeat both guardians ([Guardian Scout I](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246691) and [Guardian Scout II](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246692)) roaming the room.
3. Get Treasure Chest #1.
4. Blow up the column of cracked blocks on the side of the door. Then, Magnesis the door to carry it as a bridge.
5. Use the door to walk from pillar to pillar, starting from the bottom-right pillar, to the top-right pillar, to the monk to complete the trial.

**Treasure:** 
1. [Traveler's Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246689) - In a room, to the left of the main room. Magnesis the doors to enter.
2. [Opal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246688) - On a column of blocks, on top of the top-left pillar. Bridge your way from the top-right pillar, then Magnesis the chest down.
3. [Gold Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246690) - Hidden inside the top-right pillar. Magnesis away a block on the top side of the pillar to access.

locations.title: Shora Hah Shrine
locations.description:
## Blue Flame

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Magnesis the sliding spiked block up while moving past.
2. Turn left, and slide the blocks to form a staircase.
3. Light the torch with the blue flame, then light the unlit torch in the center of the crossroads to open the gate.
4. Bring the blue flame to the unlit torch, avoiding the water spouts. Alternatively, shoot an arrow to the unlit torch through the blue flame before walking to it.
5. Wait for the elevator to be low, then shoot an arrow through the blue flame to ignite it, triggering the staircase to complete.
6. Step on the pressure plate to lower the ramp, then Magnesis the spiked ball away and run up the ramp.
7. Defeat the four Guardian Scouts I, then light the torch on the left side of the gate.
8. Light the central torch in the next room. Then, Stasis one of the water spouts and light the torch in front of it. Light the final torch before the Stasis runs out.
9. Light the torch on the left. Then, light an arrow, and wait for both platform to align in the center to light both at the same time.
10. Ride the air currents to the second platform, then shoot through the flame to light the torch.
11. Light the torch atop the sliding block. Then, Stasis the water spout, and Magnesis the block to the other side.
12. Set fire to the leaf carpet to destroy the three Guardians, then carry the flame to the torch behind them.
13. Light a torch, step in the middle of the torches and perform a Charged Attack. This should light all the torches simultaneously and complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Royal Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247147) - On a platform, left of the blue flame. Move the sliding blocks left to create a pathway.
2. [Great Flameblade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247145) - In the four Guardians room, on the right side.
3. [Giant Ancient Core](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247144) - In the four Guardians room, on the left side.
4. [Forest Dweller's Sword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247146) - Past the sliding block, behind the black column to the right. Ride the air current and paraglide to it.
5. [Silver Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247142) - On a pillar, behind the sliding block. Grab it using Magnesis.
6. [Ice Arrow x10](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247143) - Near the monk, just past the platform with three Guardians.

locations.title: Shae Mo'sah Shrine
locations.description:
## Swinging Flames

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Shoot the lantern in the hole in the ceiling to drop it on the leaves, burning the platform and dropping the barrel.
2. Place the barrel on the pressure plate.
3. Turn right and defeat all three Guardians.
4. Climb the ramp to the left to the next room.
5. Step on the pressure plate up the ramp to drop a lantern.
6. Magnesis the lantern against the leaves to burn away the platform and drop the ball in the groove.
7. Circle around the fence to find a pressure plate. Step on it to release the ball on the wheel and open a barred door.
8. Grab the Small Key past the door, and return to the locked door just past the guardians room.
9. Press the central pressure plate to drop two lanterns. Magnesis one to swing it forward, Stasis it when it's over the leaves and shoot the rope.
10. Place the dropped barrel on the second pressure plate to unlock the door and complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Stone Smasher](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247136) - Past the first door, to the left.
2. [Ruby](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247135) - In the corner of the room with the three guardians.
3. [Ice Arrow x10](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247137) - Past the second pressure plate; drop down on the chest.

locations.title: Qua Raym Shrine
locations.description:
## A Balanced Approach

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Walk to the left torch, near the locked room.
2. Shoot the wooden crate atop the plate through the torch to burn it and lower the other plate.
3. Grab the Small Key from the now-lowered chest and unlock the door.
4. Bring the three blocks near the scales. Jump on the one with the chest, along with one of the blocks.
5. Magnesis the other 2 blocks on the other plate. The plate with Link should rise, yet not crush on the spikes.
6. Blow up the cracked blocks to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Knight's Claymore](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247134) - On a tall pillar against the left wall. After unlocking the metal block, use one to lower the plate next to the chest. Then, use the central scales to rise Link in the air and paraglide to that plate. Finally, use the metal block to raise the scale to the chest.

locations.title: Mirro Shaz Shrine
locations.description:
## Tempered Power

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Drop down the shaft, and grab the [Iron Sledgehammer](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247091) from the chest.
2. Stasis the orb, and build momentum towards the archway beyond the water. The orb should fly to the goal and open the next room.
3. Stasis the sliding block and build momentum away. The block should hit the stone slab and rotate it.
4. Climb the ladder and walk across the stone slab.
5. Walk to the monk to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Iron Sledgehammer](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247092) - Instead of walking to the monk, go in the left hallway and drop down to a new room. The chest is in the middle.
2. [Giant Ancient Core](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247094) - In a locked room, behind Treasure Chest #1. Stasis the orb, and build momentum towards the goal to open the room.

locations.title: Sheh Rata Shrine
locations.description:
## Speed of Light

**Location:** Atop a rocky hill; burn away the vines to access.  
**Solution:**
1.  Shoot the switch on the right to raise the water level.
2. (Optional - See Treasure #2) Cryonis your way to the switch, leave a square bomb beside it, and make your way back.
3. Rotate the giant wheel a quarter of a turn. Then, _quickly_ swim across the pool, into the open archway.
4. Wait for the water level to drop, then Magnesis the barrel on the pressure plate.
5. Walk to the monk to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Opal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246649) - On a lower ledge, just right of the entrance. Drop down while the water level is down to access.
2. [Giant Boomerang](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246650) - On a high ledge, beside the monk. After completing the shrine, blow up your bomb to raise the water level, then Cryonis your way up the ledge.

locations.title: Daka Tuss Shrine
locations.description:
## Sunken Scoop

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Magnesis the metal bowl from the bottom of the pool.
2. Using the bowl, scoop a glowing ball from the pool and drop it in the caged area.
3. Move the next room, carrying the metal bowl.
4. Using the bowl, scoop a glowing ball from the pool and drop it on top of the caged area.
5. Drop the bowl in the pool, on top of the pressure plate.
6. Drop down in the pool and proceed to the next room to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Silver Longsword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246651) - After completing the shrine, return to the first room and drop down in the pool. The chest is in a secret room beyond the pool.

locations.title: Ta'Loh Naeg Shrine
locations.description:

2. Step through the now open gate to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**

2. [Eightfold Blade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246612) - In the open room, to the left of the starting point.
3. [Opal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246613) - Just past the gate.

locations.title: Ha Dahamar Shrine
locations.description:
## The Water Guides

**Location:** In the middle of the pond. To access, jump over the reeds using Cryonis.  
**Solution:**
1. Cryonis the water to create a pillar.
2. Cryonis the waterfall to create a horizontal pillar.
3. Walk halfway up the staircase.
4. Using Cryonis, guide the falling boulder into the goal. Create the following pillars:
    - After the first slope, so the boulder falls on the seesaw;
    - Under the left side of the seesaw, so it stays slanted to the right;
    - Between the seesaw and the goal, so the boulder doesn't fall in the hole.
5. Walk to the now open grate to complete the trial.

**Treasure:**
1. [Purple Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246602) - On a ledge, high between the two waterfalls. To access, after crossing the second waterfall, turn around and Cryonis horizontal pillars up to the ledge.

locations.title: Shee Vaneer Shrine
locations.description:
## Twin Memories

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Move the glowing boulders so they match the original pattern of [Shee Venath Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225235). See the screenshot for the pattern.
2. Climb the ladder behind the now open grate to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Eightfold Longblade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246608) - On a tall pillar, against the near wall. From the starting point, turn left and ride the elevator up. From there, paraglide around the black column and land on the pillar.

locations.description:
## Twin Memories

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**

locations.title: Ree Dahee Shrine
locations.description:
## Timing Is Critical

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Step on the plate to slant the slate until the ball rolls into the goal.
2. Move across the gap using the moving platform.
3. Step on the plate to slant the slates; step off as the ball reaches about 2/3rds of the first slate. Adjust the timing as needed, so the ball ultimately rolls into the goal.
4. Move across the gap using the moving platform.
5. Step on the plate to slant the slate; step off as the ball reaches about 3/4rds of the slate, so it launches into the air and into the goal. Adjust the timing as needed.
6. Climb up the ramp to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Climber's Bandanna](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246609) - On a platform, near the end of the shrine. From the final platform, look down towards the final goal to see a pair of barrels. Magnesis a barrel on the previous plate to slant the slate and grant access to the chest.

locations.title: Toto Sah Shrine
locations.description:
## Toto Sah Apparatus

**Location:** In the cliffside, at water level; blow up the rocky wall to access.  
**Solution:**
1. Interact with the first terminal to rotate the floating pillar into a bridge.
2. Interact with the second terminal to rotate the stairs. From their starting position:
    - Press **down** to rotate them towards link, until the middle staircase is aligned with the others;
    - Press **up** to rotate them back straight.
    - Press **left** to rotate them and connect both platforms.
3. Interact with the third terminal to rotate the structure:
    - First, rotate until you have access to a chest; grab the _Small Key_ from it.
    - Then, rotate it until you connect both platforms.
4. Open the door with the _Small Key_ to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Shield of the Mind's Eye](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246618) - On a side of the first floating pillar; rotate it until it faces up.

locations.title: Shai Utoh Shrine
locations.description:
## Halt the Tilt

**Location:** Inside the mountain; blow up the cracked wall to the northwest to access.  
**Solution:**
1. Stasis the seesaw to prevent it from tilting, then climb up.
2. Tilt the seesaw to the right, then Stasis it and climb up the ledge.
3. Grab Treasure Chest #1 (see below).
4. Tilt the seesaw backwards (lower the far side), and Magnesis the chest to keep it in place.
5. Climb the seesaw, then Stasis the last seesaw straight. Cross it to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Traveler's Sword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246681) - From the ledge past the second seesaw, look back towards the right side of the seesaw. Grab the chest using Magnesis.
2. [Ancient Core](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246682) - On a high ledge, on the far end of the shrine. Tilt the third seesaw forwards (front side lowered) and step on it. Using Magnesis, grab Treasure Chest #1 and place it high above the seesaw. Drop it to launch Link high in the air, then paraglide to the chest.

locations.title: Shoda Sah Shrine
locations.description:
## Impeccable Timing

**Location:** Behind the waterfall.  
**Solution:**
1. Place a glowing ball between the two triangular blocks to the left of the entrance.
2. Hit the nearby switch to launch the ball towards the goal; time it so it doesn't hit the moving blockers.
3. Grab the Small Key from the chest that fell just behind the launcher.
4. Unlock the door at the end of the corridor to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Ice Arrow x5](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246664) - Repeat the above process with the right launcher; the chest will fall from the wall, right of the launcher.

locations.title: Gorae Torr Shrine
locations.description:
## Gorae Torr's Blessing

**Location:** ??  
**Shrine quest:** [The Gut Check Challenge](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247164)  
**Solution:**
1. Walk to the monk to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Great Frostblade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247162) - In the middle of the room.

locations.title: Daqa Koh Shrine
locations.description:
## Stalled Flight

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Drop down to the pillars below, against the stone block.
2. When the pillars activate, paraglide towards the block; Link will fall down slower and move on the block.
3. When the block is near the ceiling, Stasis it. The power source should connect and open the gate.
4. Paraglide to the gate to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Silver Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247141) - On a high ledge, just right of the entrance. Paraglide from the central block when launched into the air.

locations.title: Kayra Mah Shrine
locations.description:
## Greedy Hill

**Location:** ??  
**Shrine quest:** [A Brother's Roast](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247157)  
**Solution:**
1. Wait for a large metal ball to fall down the hill.
2. Magnesis the ball in front of Link while moving up the ramp.
3. Walk to the monk to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Bomb Arrow x5](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247156) - On a high ledge, on the left side at the top of the ramp. Paraglide to it from the doorway.
2. [Ruby](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247155) - In an alcove against the right wall. Climb all the way up to stop the traps, then walk to the chest.

locations.title: Mo'a Keet Shrine
locations.description:
## Metal Makes a Path

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Stasis the rolling boulder up the ramp, then run up to the crossroads before the Stasis runs out.
2. Turn right, and Magnesis the metal boulder.
3. Bring the boulder left of the crossroads, and use it to push your way up the ramp.
4. Walk to the monk to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Ruby](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247130) - On top of a few cracked boulders, in the ceiling right of the entrance. Magnesis the metal boulder down the first ramp, and use it to break the blocks.
2. [Knight's Broadsword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247131) - At the end of the ramp with the metal boulder. Magnesis the boulder all the way up the ramp.

locations.title: Sah Dahaj Shrine
locations.description:
## Power of Fire

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Burn away the leaves on the wall to reveal the hole in it.
2. Defeat the [Guardian Scout II](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247133)
3. Climb the ladder, and shoot an arrow through the hanging lantern to burn away the leaves and reveal another hole.
4. Look in the cage to see a stone slab over a pressure plate, supported by two crates. Burn away the leaf trails leading to the crates to drop the slab on the pressure plate and complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Knight's Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247132) - In the 3rd room, on a high ledge just right of the entrance. Burn away the leaves on the wall underneath to burn the platform and drop the chest.

locations.title: Tah Muhl Shrine
locations.description:
## Passing the Flame

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Burn away the leaves directly in front of the entrance. You can use the torch at the end of the right hallway to light an arrow, a torch or a wooden weapon.
2. In the 2nd room, destroy the crates to drop the ramp and complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Opal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247129) - In the 2nd room, on top of a stack of crates. Destroy or burn them away to drop the chest.
2. [Ruby](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247128) - Past the locked door in the 2nd room. Burn the leaves to the left of the door to drop a Small Key. Magnesis the Small Key over the fence to access the chest.
3. [Cobble Crusher](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247127) - In the 2nd room, in an alcove. Looking at the monk, look behind the leaves on the right wall.

locations.title: Soh Kofi Shrine
locations.description:
## A Minor Test of Strength

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Defeat the [Guardian Scout II](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246642)
2. Walk through the gate to complete the trial.

**Treasure:**
1. [Knight's Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246641) - Just past the gate.

locations.title: Dow Na'eh Shrine
locations.description:
## Three Boxes

**Location:** In a cave, behind the waterfall; access by following the tunnel to the west of it.  
**Solution:**
1. Grab all 3 chests, and place them on the pressure plate.
2. Magnesis the metal block on the moving pillar. When it comes down, jump on top of the block to access the higher ledge.
3. Walk to the monk to complete the trial.

**Treasure:**
1. [Opal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246631) - At the bottom of the basin, behind the pressure plate. Grab it with Magnesis.
2. [Zora Sword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246632) - On a wooden ledge, on the left wall. Shoot both ropes of the ledge to drop the chest in the water, then grab it with Magnesis.
3. [Amber](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246633) - On top of the moving pillar, behind the pressure plate.

locations.title: Yah Rin Shrine
locations.description:
## A Weighty Decision

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Step on the plate with the metal block.
2. Magnesis the block on the other plate to raise Link.
3. Defeat the [Guardian Scout II](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246658).
4. Magnesis the block over the fence and on the pressure plate, beside the grate.
5. In the room with two sets of scales, Magnesis the block to tip the back scale to the right.
6. Step on the plate with the block, then Magnesis the block to tip the scale to the left, rising Link and completing the trial.

**Treasure:**
1. [Opal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246659) - On a pillar, to the left of the room with two sets of scales. Use the block to tip the back scale to the left. Then, step on the scale, and Magnesis the block to tip it right, rising Link to the chest.
2. [Knight's Broadsword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246660) - Behind the fence, at the end of the first hallway. Magnesis the chest over the fence.

locations.title: Ze Kasho Shrine
