## Ze Kasho Apparatus

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Rotate the platform to slide the spikes so the central path is clear.
2. Hit the switch to rotate the stone slabs and block the lasers; run past the first slab and wait.
3. Shoot the switch to rotate them again. This time, run to the archway.
4. Rotate the platform so one ball falls in every nook.
5. Walk to the monk to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Silverscale Spear](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247115) - In the laser room, on a high ledge to the right. After getting past the lasers, shoot the switch so the black pillar overhead rotates under the platform. Shoot the switch again, this time jumping on the black pillar as it comes back around, and paraglide to the chest.

locations.title: Ne'ez Yohma Shrine
locations.description:
## Pushing Power

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Run up the slope, dodging the falling boulders. Stasis the laser to cross it safely.
2. Using Cryonis, guide the glowing ball into the goal. Make the following pillars:
    - In the waterfall behind it, to push it on the slope. It will get stuck behind a block with a notch on top.
    - Under the ball. It will rise over the block through the notch, and roll towards a triangular block.
    - Between the two blocks, so the ball rolls over the hole. It will get stuck behind another block with a notch.
    - Under the ball. It will rise over the block through the notch, and roll towards a triangular block.
    - Halfway down the triangular block, to keep the ball on the right side.
    - Under the ball. It will rise over the block and in the goal.

**Treasure:**
1. [Zora Spear](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246638) - In a chest, on top of a block. After climbing up the slope, paraglide directly to it.

locations.title: Rucco Maag Shrine
locations.description:
## Five Flames

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Light up all 5 torches on the cubes, without extinguishing them with the water spout. This can be done in a few ways:
    - Hit the top switch once, then light the torches using Fire Arrows.
    - If you have Flint and Wood, drop and hit them to make a brazier. Then, light the torches by igniting your arrows.
    - Hit the switches in the following order (assuming Link is behind the cube, facing the torches): Right, Top, Back, Left, Front, Right, Top, Back, Top. The lit torch will spread to the others.

**Treasure:**
1. [Opal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246639) - On a wooden ledge, high against the back wall to the left. Shoot a flaming arrow at the wall to drop the chest.
2. [Silver Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246640) - On a wooden ledge, high against the back wall to the right. Shoot a flaming arrow at the wall to drop the chest.

locations.title: Kah Mael Shrine
locations.description:
## Drop and Rise

**Location:** Under a stone slab; use Stasis to knock it away.  
**Solution:**
1. Drop the wooden platform by shooting at both ropes.
2. While standing on one plate of the scale, Magnesis the metal block above the other plate.
3. Drop the metal block; this will launch Link into the air. Paraglide to the platform to complete the trial.

**Treasure:**

locations.title: Yowaka Ita Shrine
locations.description:
## EX Champions' Ballad DLC Quest

**Location:** Forest of Spirits, near a fallen tree 
**Solution:**
1. Defeat the enemy camp to reveal it.
2. Brave several areas full of moving balls of various sizes and spikes. To avoid them, try running along the side and jumping up on a ledge and make your way to the catwalks on either side.
3. At the next area - you must use the provided metal bowl to collect the Shrine Orb as it tumbles out with other balls and objects along the side.
4. With the small orb back in the cup, don't dump it out yet - and head back to the first slope with the moving objects and extend the bowl carefully across to the other side and leave it so you can cross without having to worry about using Magnesis at the same time.

**Treasure:**
1. Bomb Arrows
2. Phrenic Bow

locations.title: Rohta Cigah Shrine
locations.description:
## EX Champions' Ballad DLC Quest

**Location:** North of the Eastern Abby in the Great Plateau region, South of the Great Plateau Tower - but you must defeat the enemy camp to reveal it.
**Solution:**
1. Defeat the enemy camp to make it appear
2. Angle the platforms to build a walkway to the right side, you can climb up to the ledge to get a chest holding a Forest Dweller's Shield.
3. Avoid the spikes and use Statis to stop a conveyor belt to get across.
4. Glide between three giant spiked balls dangling from the roof.
5. Run from the spiked wall and survive the traps.

**Treasure:**
1. Forest Dweller's Shield

locations.title: Ruvo Korbah Shrine
locations.description:
## EX Champions' Ballad DLC Quest

**Location:** South of the Temple of Time, in the fields near the Old Man's hut - but you must defeat the enemy camp to reveal it.

**Solution:**

**Treasure:**

2. Giant Ancient Core

locations.title: Etsu Korima Shrine
locations.description:
## EX Champions' Ballad DLC Quest

**Location:** Below Mount Hylia to the North, just South above the River of the Dead - but you must defeat the enemy camp to reveal it.
**Solution:**
1. Use weapons or Stasis to light up the dark and avoid the traps.
2. Defeat the three Guardian Scouts

**Treasure:**
1. Gold Rupee

locations.title: Kee Dafunia Shrine
locations.description:
## EX Champion Mipha's Song DLC Quest

**Location:** In the Lanayru Sea past Ankel Island and Knuckel Island - but you solve a puzzle to reveal it.
**Solution:**
1. Head to Ulria Grotto to the Northeast of the Zora's Domain. Here you will find Tottika and Muzu, who will give you another clue to the trial.
2. Sit at the nearby campfire until morning, and look out over the ocean between Ankel Island and Knuckel Island.
3. Along the water, you can spot a faint glowing blue portal - glide down to it to reveal a new shrine in the water.
4. Melt ice blocks to solve the puzzles.

**Treasure:**
1. Diamond

locations.title: Sato Koda Shrine
locations.description:
## EX Champion Mipha's Song DLC Quest

**Location:** In Upland Zorana in the hills to the West of Toto Lake, found by climbing up the waterfall dams North of Zora's Domain - but you must clear out enemies to reveal it.
**Solution:**
1. Inside, use Cryonis on the wall to influence where the ball goes.

**Treasure:**
1. Giant Ancient Core

locations.title: Mah Eliya Shrine
locations.description:
## EX Champion Mipha's Song DLC Quest
**Location:** Below Ploymus Mountain to the North, up past Mikau and Lulu Lake up the waterfall dams - but you must solve a puzzle to reveal it.

**Solution:**
1. Use Magnesis to lift the left box up into the air, and while it falls, quickly pull out Cryonis and place a block below the falling box to keep it raised, and climb up to the platform.
2. Now that you have a ice block under the metal box on the left, you can either try lifting up the metal block further and use stasis before it falls - or use Magnesis on the small metal block to lift up the left block from underneath, next to the Cryonis block.
3. Now for the other side - get to the top of the left metal box and raise up the the right box as high as you can and use stasis before it drops. 

**Treasure:**
1. Royal Shield

locations.title: Kamia Omuna Shrine
locations.description:
## EX Champion Daruk's Song DLC Quest.

**Location:** North of Lake Darman in the Northern reaches of Death Mountain - but you must defeat a mighty foe to reveal it.
**Solution:**
1. Defeath the Igneo Talus 
2. Insert a Round Remote Bomb and hit the switch to pan the cannon. As it passes over the target, explode your bomb to send the ball hurtling into the target - knocking it down and revealing a new target further back.
3. Aim the cannon at the chest to break the platform its on and send it crashing down below - and use Magnesis to pull the chest over that holds a Diamond.
4. Shoot the moving targets.

**Treasure:**
1. Diamond

locations.title: Sharo Lun Shrine
locations.description:
## EX Champion Daruk's Song DLC Quest

**Location:** Sharo Lun Shrine is located down the slopes East of Death Mountain across the Death Caldera from the volcano - but you must pass a trial to reveal it.
**Solution:**
1. Warp to Divine Beast Vah Rudania and look along the rim to spot a glowing blue portal.
2. Follow the blue portals to open the shrine
3. Hold onto a safe part of the block when passing through the flames to beat this obstacle course.
4. Defeat the Guardian Scouts
5. To grab the perpetually falling chest, use Cryonis to make platforms you can jump to and get to more sturdy ground, then make a new ice platform to catch the chest holding a Great Flameblade.
6. Create new Cryonis platforms out of the waterfall to jump down to, and make stairs out of the ice to get to the Monk.

**Treasure:**
1. Great Flameblade

locations.title: Rinu Honika Shrine
locations.description:
## EX Champion Daruk's Song DLC Quest

**Location:** On the South side of the Darb Pond, South of the Bridge of Eldin - but you must pass a trial to reveal it.
**Solution:**
1. Look along the Western banks of the pond to find a giant metal crate, and use Magnesis to carefully guide it to the ring.
2. From up on the clifftop, glide your way down and drop onto the metal box.
3. Avoid the flame jets.
4. Throw a Remote Bomb down and detonate to send the pillar down a notch and the bottom flame down below. 
5. Use the metal block as a shield to strafe the other flames with the block in front of them.
6. Make a passage through the fire with metal blocks.
7. Flip the contraption upside-down until you see two E-shaped sections on each end, and angle them so that they face and block the flame jets on both sides. 

**Treasure:**
1. Stone Smasher

locations.title: Shira Gomar Shrine
locations.description:
## EX Champion Revali's Song DLC Quest

**Location:** On the South side of Tanagar Canyon, located to the South of Hebra Tower, and just North of Upland Lindor - but you must complete a trial to reveal it.
**Solution:**
1. Travel to the Hebra Tower and glide down Southwest until you reach this shelf - and look for the campfire of the Rito Guard Mazli. 
2. If you wait at the camp until night, you'll spot the great dragon Dinraal around 1AM as he makes his way by from the East. Hop off and loose an arrow at his glowing horn, and the shrine will be revealed.
3. Stand a few paces back from the final wind gust and toss a bomb onto it and launch it up and detonate it when it's near the stones. 
4. Up on the other side, you'll spot a tube to put a Round Remote Bomb in and it will fly off towards the far wall that you can also detonate - wait for the bomb to start dropping in height before blowing it up.
5. Ride the gusts up to the next level where two spinning gusts are on a middle platform, with two slots for bombs to shoot out. 
6. Use Stasis to freeze the fan that triggers the gate to close - or Stasis the platform as it centers on the wall and wait for the fan to stop spinning.
7. Fly up into the next section, and up across the last few gusts to the Monk.

**Treasure:**
1. Bomb Arrows

locations.title: Kiah Toza Shrine
locations.description:
##  EX Champion Revali's Song DLC Quest

**Location:** On the Eastern edges of the Pikida Stonegrove, East of the Hebra Peak and Summit - but you must complete a trial to reveal it.
**Solution:**
1. Head up the mountain from Hebra Tower to find the slope - and a portal in the snow.
2. You'll need to start shield-surfing here and race down this long slope while sliding into all the portals that appear along the way.
3. Help the orb on its journey by moving down the path.

**Treasure:**
1. Falcon Bow

locations.title: Noe Rajee Shrine
locations.description:
## EX Champion Revali's Song DLC Quest

**Location:** At the Flight Range North of Dronoc's Path and the Rito Village - but you must complete a trial to reveal it. 
**Solution:**
1. Warp to the Sha Warvo Shrine and head into the Flight Range itself. The targets here have taken on a blue glow - but just hitting one while falling isn't enough.
2. Instead, float around until you have four targets in close range, and while in slow motion - shoot all four targets before you come out of focus, which may require some extra stamina.
3. Use wind gusts to glide and shoot switches.

**Treasure:**
1. Shield of the Mind's Eye

locations.title: Keive Tala Shrine
locations.description:

locations.description:

locations.title: Kihiro Moh Shrine
locations.description:
## EX Champion Urbosa's Song DLC Quest

**Location:** At the end of the Yiga Clan Hideout hidden in the valley of the Gerudo Highlands, near the giant pit - but you must complete a trial to reveal it.
**Solution:**
1. Travel to the Gerudo Tower and up and over the ridge to the arena where you fought Master Khoga - and the giant pit you sent him down. Down here, look for the twin adventurers Mina and Mils.
2. Climb up the ladder and cross the foortops to the second floor to grab the orb.
3. Toss the orb in the pit.
4. Place the colored orbs to match the number of torches on the wall: Blue - 4, Red -1, Yellow - 2, Green - 2.

**Treasure:**
1. Thunderspear

locations.title: Akkala Ancient Tech Lab
locations.description:

locations.title: Flight Range
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Complete the Divine Beast quest  
**How to start:** Speak with [Tulin](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248296)  
**Cost:** Free  
**Objective:** Destroy as many targets as possible within 30 seconds. Use the updrafts and the Paraglider to move around the Flight Range.  
**Rewards:**
- Between 0 and 4 targets: Nothing
- Between 5 and 9 targets: Red Rupee
- Between 10 and 14 targets: Purple Rupee
- Between 15 and 19 targets: Silver Rupee
- 20 targets: Gold Rupee

locations.title: Sand-Seal Racing
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Free the Divine Beast Vah Naboris  
**How to start:** Speak with [Shabonne](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246895)  
**Cost:** 50 Rupees (100 after completing The Undefeated Champion)  
**Objective:** Surfing on a shield tied to a Sand Seal, finish the race as fast as possible.  
**Rewards:**
- While completing [The Undefeated Champion](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246897): Finish the race under 1:30.00 to gain a trophy and advance the quest.
- After completing The Undefeated Champion: Beat your previous record for a Gold Rupee.

locations.title: Gut Check Rock Challenge
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Bayge](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247163)  
**Objective:** Climb to the top of Gut Check Rock within 3 minutes, gathering enough Rupees along the way. In addition to the reward, Link may keep the gathered Rupees on a success.  

_Gut Check Challenge:_
- **Cost:** 50 Rupees
- **Rupee goal:** 100 Rupees
- **Reward:** Rushroom

_Super Gut Check Challenge:_
- **Cost:** 100 Rupees
- **Rupee goal:** 300 Rupees
- **Reward:** Endura Shroom

locations.title: All or Nothing
Obstacle Course
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Blynne](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247464)  
**Cost:** 20 Rupees  
**Objective:** Jump over the 10 obstacles and come back to the stable as fast as possible.  
**Rewards:**
- [Extravagant Bridle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247466): Completion under 1:30.00
- [Extravagant Saddle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247467): Completion under 1:15.00

locations.title: Selmie's Shield-Surfing
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Have a shield equipped  
**How to start:** Speak with [Selmie](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248294)  
**Cost:** 20 Rupees  
**Objective:** Race down the slope as fast as possible.  
**Rewards:**  
_Beginner's Course_:
- Over 1:00.00: Nothing
- 1:00.00 and under: Access to the Advanced Course

_Advanced Course_: Each reward can only be obtained once.
- Over 4:00.00: Nothing
- 3:20.01 to 4:00.00: [Wooden Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245386)
- 3:05.01 to 3:20.00: [Hunter's Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245513)
- 2:50.01 to 3:05.00: [Emblazoned Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245521)
- 2:35.01 to 2:50.00: [Fisherman's Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245515)
- 2:20.01 to 2:35.00: [Traveler's Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245526)
- 2:05.01 to 2:20.00: [Kite Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245550)
- 1:50.01 to 2:05.00: [Soldier's Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245404)
- 1:35.01 to 1:50.00: [Knight's Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245416)
- 1:35.00 and under: [Royal Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245507)

locations.title: Snowling

locations.title: 001 Skilled Assembly Voice Memory
locations.description: The 001 Skilled Assembly Voice Memory can be found in Hyrule Castle, located right outside the front gates, north of Castle Town Ruins.

locations.title: 002 Dreading Banquets Voice Memory
locations.description: The 002 Dreading Banquets Voice Memory can be found inside Hyrule Castle, on the southeast side of the castle, inside a room called the Dining Hall.

locations.title: 003 Down Below... Voice Memory
locations.description: The 003 Down Below... Voice Memory can be found at Hyrule Castle, on a balcony overlooking the front gates on the south side of the castle.

locations.title: 004 The Protective Gate Voice Memory
locations.description: The 004 The Protective Gate Voice Memory can be found on the path up to Hyrule Castle, inside a building called the First Gatehouse.

locations.title: 005 A Stream of Support Voice Memory
locations.description: The 005 A Stream of Support Voice Memory can be found inside Hyrule Castle, specifically in the Guards' Chamber on the southwest side of the castle. By stepping onto the landing on the first level of this chamber, you can trigger the Voice Memory.

locations.title: 006 Rusted Prison Voice Memory
locations.description: The 006 Rusted Prison Voice Memory can be found inside Hyrule Castle, within the Lockup section on the northwest side of the castle.

locations.title: 007 Busy Days Voice Memory
locations.description: The 007 Busy Days Voice Memory can be found inside Hyrule Castle, right beside the Saas Ko'sah Shrine on the northeast side of the castle. You cant rigger the memory by standing right beside the unlit brazier across from the shrine.

locations.title: 008 A Princess's Secret Voice Memory
locations.description: The 008 A Princess's Secret Voice Memory can be found inside Hyrule Castle, on the first floor of the Library. You can find the Library on the northeast side of the castle.

locations.title: 009 Two Thrones Voice Memory
locations.description: The 009 Two Thrones Voice Memory can be found inside Hyrule Castle, by the two thrones on the balcony overlooking the Sanctum.

locations.title: 010 The Bells That Tolls Voice Memory
locations.description: The 010 The Bells That Tolls Voice Memory can be found inside Hyrule Castle, inside the bell tower at the very top of the castle.

locations.title: 011 Sleepless Nights Voice Memory
locations.description: The 011 Sleepless Nights Voice Memory can be found inside Hyrule Castle, inside Princess Zelda's Rooms on the west side of Hyrule Castle. Stand beside Zelda's collapsed bed to trigger this voice memory.

locations.title: 012 The Princess's Refuge Voice Memory
locations.description: The 012 The Princess's Refuge Voice Memory can be found inside Hyrule Castle, inside the tower on the west side of the castle called Princess Zelda's Study.

locations.title: 013 Memories at the Gazebo Voice Memory
locations.description: The 013 Memories at the Gazebo Voice Memory can be found outside Hyrule Castle, near the ruins of a stone gazebo on the west side of the castle.

locations.title: 014 Barred from the Prison Voice Memory
locations.description: The 014 Barred from the Prison Voice Memory can be found southwest of Hyrule Castle, on the Moat Bridge that leads from Castle Town to the Castle Town Prison west of the castle.

locations.title: 015 Origin of the Name Voice Memory
locations.description: The 015 Origin of the Name Voice Memory can be found in the Seres Scablands, and area found in the far west section of Hyrule Ridge (the eastern chunk of Central Hyrule that borders Tabantha).

locations.title: 016 Open Gate Voice Memory
locations.description: The 016 Open Gate Voice Memory can be found in the Royal Ancient Lab Ruins in North Hyrule Plain, in the western area of Central Hyrule.

locations.title: 017 Specialties Voice Memory
locations.description: The 017 Specialties Voice Memory can be found in the Salari Plains, a flat area in the north of the Lindor's Brow ridge north of the Ridgeland Shiekah Tower. The ruins found here are called the Maritta Exchange.

locations.title: 018 Solitary Moving Stable Voice Memory
locations.description: The 018 Solitary Moving Stable Voice Memory can be found just outside of the Serenne Stable in Hyrule Ridge, the large western area between Hyrule Field and the Tanagar Canyon.

locations.title: 019 Over Capacity Voice Memory
locations.description: The 019 Over Capacity Voice Memory can be found outside the Snowfield Stable in South Tabantha Snowfield. Standing just outside the stable, where you can talk to the innkeep about boarding your horse, will trigger this memory.

locations.title: 020 Village Blanketed by Snow Voice Memory
locations.description: The 020 Village Blanketed by Snow Voice Memory can be found on the southern side of the Tabantha Village Ruins, in Tabantha region.

locations.title: 021 Unwavering Devotion Voice Memory
locations.description: The 021 Unwavering Devotion Voice Memory can be found in the Hebra Mountains, just outside the Rito Stable to the east of Rito Village itself. Standing in front of the Stable by the innkeep will trigger this memory.

locations.title: 022 Divine Beast of Wind Voice Memory
locations.description: The 022 Divine Beast of Wind Voice Memory can be found just outside Rito Village in the Hebra Mountains. Stepping up to the very first bridge which spans across towards the Rito Village from the eastern side will trigger this memory.

locations.title: 023 Medoh's Perch Voice Memory
locations.description: The 023 Medoh's Perch Voice Memory can be found in Rito Village in the Hebra Mountains. To trigger this memory, you will need to stand on the third island on the path that leads east to west into Rito Village.

locations.title: 024 Soaring Village Voice Memory
locations.description: The 024 Soaring Village Voice Memory can be found in Rito Village in the Hebra Mountains. To trigger this memory, you must follow the path across the islands to the Rito Village entrance at the base of the giant pillar. Standing beneath the colorful archway will trigger the memory.

locations.title: 025 Feathered Traditions Voice Memory
locations.description: The 025 Feathered Traditions Voice Memory can be found in Rito Village in the Hebra Mountains. To trigger this memory, climb up the Rito Village staircases until you see the armor shop on the right-hand side. The flags hanging outside are marked by shirt icons. Step inside the Rito Village armor shop.

locations.title: 026 Masterful Performance Voice Memory
locations.description: The 026 Masterful Performance Voice Memory can be found in Rito Village in the Hebra Mountains. To trigger this memory, climb up the Rito Village staircases until you see the small building to the right with a lit cooking pot. You can find this building just one level above the armor shop, midway up the village.

locations.title: 027 Iron-Clad Force Voice Memory
locations.description: The 027 Iron-Clad Force Voice Memory can be found in Rito Village in the Hebra Mountains. To trigger this memory, climb up the Rito Village staircases towards the very top of the village. You will find the location inside the building where the Rito elder resides.

locations.title: 028 Bedraggled Wings Voice Memory
locations.description: The 028 Bedraggled Wings Voice Memory can be found in Hebra, in a location north of Rito Village and Lake Totori called Drocnoc's Pass. This is also where you will find the Flight Range, a strange, circular chasm in the mountains that generates its own updraft of wind.

locations.title: 029 Secret Rito Spring Voice Memory
locations.description: The 029 Secret Rito Spring Voice Memory can be found in the far north of Hebra, in a location called Goflam's Secret Hot Springs on your map. Reaching this hot spring will prove difficult, as you'll need to scale the Hebra Mountains to get there.

locations.title: 030 The Scar's Story Voice Memory
locations.description: The 030 The Scar's Story Voice Memory can be found in the far north of Hebra, at the very foot of Hebra Peak (the peak on the eastern side of the Hebra Mountains). If you stand beneath the Hebra Peak, looking towards a lone lean-to tent and ice block, you will trigger this memory.

locations.title: 031 Forgotten Temple Voice Memory
locations.description: The 031 Forgotten Temple Voice Memory can be found inside the Forgotten Temple in the far north side of Tanagar Canyon. You can find this canyon northwest of Great Hyrule Forest. Standing at the steps leading up to the giant Goddess Statue at the very back of the temple will trigger this memory.

locations.title: 032 Slumbering Ruins Voice Memory
locations.description: The 032 Slumbering Ruins Voice Memory can be found just north of the Great Hyrule Forest, on the western bridge leading into the Typhlo Ruins.

locations.title: 033 An Atypical Request Voice Memory
locations.description: The 033 An Atypical Request Voice Memory can be found at the Foothill Stable in Eldin. You can find this stable along the path north of Lanayru Wetlands, headings towards Death Mountain.

locations.title: Follow the Sheikah Slate
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**Steps:**
1. From out of nowhere, you hear a woman's voice speak to you... She instructs you to head to the [marker](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246222) displayed on the Sheikah Slate.

**Next quest:** [The Isolated Plateau](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248304)

locations.title: The Isolated Plateau
locations.description:
**Requirements:** [Follow the Sheikah Slate](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248303)  
**Steps:**
1. After your descent from the tower, the old man told you that the kingdom of Hyrule was destroyed 100 years ago by Calamity Ganon.  
You heard a voice coming from Hyrule Castle, but you cannot reach it unless you leave the plateau using the paraglider.  
The old man said that he will give you the paraglider in exchange for a treasure that lies within a [hidden location](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225212) somewhere...
2. The Old Man explained that there are a total of four Shrines on the plateau. He said that he will give you the Paraglider once you have acquired the Spirit Orb from all the of the Shrines.  
He told you to survey the plateau from the top of the tower to find the remaining shrines ([Keh Namut Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225203), [Ja Baij Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225211), [Owa Daim Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225214)). He also pointed out that you can use your Sheikah Slate if you need to travel quickly.
3. After you acquired the Spirit Orbs from the shrines, the old man told you that he'll be waiting in [the place centered amid the four shrines](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246220), before mysteriously disappearing...

**Next quest:**
- [Seek Out Impa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248305)
- [Destroy Ganon](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248307)

locations.title: Seek Out Impa
locations.description:
**Requirements:** [The Isolated Plateau](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248304)  
**Steps:**
1. You were tasked with going to Kakariko Village to speak with [Impa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248306), who will give you more details on your quest.  
Descend from the Great Plateau and head east beyond the Dueling Peaks, then follow the road to the north. The blinking dot on your Sheikah Slate's map will guide the way.

**Next quest:**
- [Locked Mementos](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248308)
- [Free the Divine Beasts](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248311)

locations.title: Destroy Ganon
locations.description:
**Requirements:** [The Isolated Plateau](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248304)  
**Steps:**
1. The ghost of King Rhoam told you that Hyrule is on the brink of annihilation.  
Princess Zelda is currently fighting to contain Calamity Ganon inside Hyrule Castle, but her power cannot keep him at bay forever. Eventually, Ganon will regain his full strength and destroy the world.  
Your ultimate task is to aid Princess Zelda in defeating Ganon before that can happen.

**Next quest:** Congratulations, you have completed Breath of the Wild!

locations.title: Locked Mementos
locations.description:
**Requirements:** [Seek Out Impa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248305)  
**Steps:**
1. According to Impa, the Sheikah Slate that Zelda left to guide you is incomplete.  
The director at the Hateno Ancient Tech Lab in Hateno Village may know a way to restore the Sheikah Slate's missing components.  
Use the map to find the location of the [Hateno Ancient Tech Lab](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247203) and its [director](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247204).
2. The Hateno Ancient Tech Lab's director can't fix the Sheikah Slate until the Guidance Stone is operational again. The only way to power the Guidance Stone is to light the furnace on the outer wall of the tech lab with a blue flame.  
Carry the blue flame from the [ancient furnace](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248309) in Hateno Village to the tech lab, and use it to light the lab's furnace.
3. The blue flame in the furnace is now powering the Hateno Ancient Tech Lab's Guidance Stone.  
Report to the director so that she can repair your Sheikah Slate.
4. Purah has fixed the Sheikah Slate, restoring the last of its basic runes from 100 years ago.  
Snap an image of Purah using the Camera rune!
5. You proved the Camera works again by capturing an image of Purah!  
According to Purah, the album already has pictures from the past in it.  
Where could these have come from? [Impa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248306) in Kakariko Village may have the answer.

**Next quest:**
- [Find the Fairy Fountain](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248654)
- [Captured Memories](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248310)

locations.title: Captured Memories
locations.description:
**Requirements:** [Locked Mementos](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248308)  
**Steps:**
1. Princess Zelda left behind an album with twelve pictures in it. Traveling to the places shown in these pictures may help you to regain your memories of the princess.  
_Editor's Note:_ Use the sidebar to find the 12 locations in question. [Zelda's Awakening](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=243834) is unavailable until you first capture the other 12 memories.
2. You've found all of the locations in the pictures!  
Go and report the news to [Impa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248306) in Kakariko Village.
3. The location of the final memory is hanging on the wall of Impa's home.  
What memory of your past with Princess Zelda awaits you there?

**Next quest:** None

locations.title: Free the Divine Beasts
locations.description:
**Requirements:** [Seek Out Impa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248305)  
**Steps:**
1. There are four Divine Beasts that must be freed. Each race's elder should have more details:
    - _Editor's Note:_ Complete each of the following quests to progress this quest.
    - The [Divine Beast Vah Rudania](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248313), piloted by Daruk of the Gorons
    - The [Divine Beast Vah Medoh](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248323), piloted by Revali of the Rito
    - The [Divine Beast Vah Ruta](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248591), piloted by Mipha of the Zora (requires [Reach Zora's Domain](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248588))
    - The [Divine Beast Vah Naboris](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248651), piloted by Urbosa of the Gerudo (requires [Forbidden City Entry](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248641))
2. You've reclaimed the four Divine Beasts by defeating the four Ganon phantoms haunting them. You should let [Impa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248306) know of your success.

**Next quest:** [Destroy Ganon](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248307)

locations.title: Divine Beast Vah Medoh
locations.description:
**Requirements:** [Seek Out Impa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248305)  
**Steps:**
1. Kaneli, elder of Rito Village, wants you to help a local soldier named Teba. You offered your assistance, but first you must find the soldier.  
Teba's wife [Saki](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248321) may know where he is. Ask around Rito Village to gather more information.
2. You found Saki and asked where Teba went. It sounds like he headed for the Flight Range.  
Search the Flight Range for [Teba](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248322).
3. You found Teba at the Flight Range, but he has no intention of returning to the village before Divine Beast Vah Medoh has been appeased.  
He intends to appease the Divine Beast himself. You had better help him out.
4. Teba won't let you anywhere near Divine Beast Vah Medoh unless you can at least hit the targets at the Flight Range.  
If you catch an updraft with your paraglider, it'll carry you high into the sky. Use this technique to destroy five targets with arrows within the time limit to prove yourself to Teba.
5. You proved your mettle by hitting the targets at the Flight Range.  
When it comes time to battle Divine Beast Vah Medoh, Teba will draw the focus of its attacks so you can focus on destroying its cannons.  
Teba will carry you into the sky where Divine Beast Vah Medoh awaits.
6. The battle with Divine Beast Vah Medoh has begun!  
Use the paraglider to launch into the air for a good vantage point, and then take out all the cannons with your bomb arrows.  
But be careful—if you get too close, you'll run into the Divine Beast's barrier!
7. You destroyed all of Divine Beast Vah Medoh's cannons and landed on its back, but Teba suffered injuries and had to retreat.  
You must finish what you both started. Enter [Divine Beast Vah Medoh](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246023) on your own to stop it once and for all!
8. You defeated Windblight Ganon, which had infested the insides of Divine Beast Vah Medoh.  
The Divine Beast has been enshrined at the highest point of Rito Village, and moreover, it looks like Teba was able to safely return to Rito Village. Go report to [Kaneli](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248320).

**Next quest:** [Free the Divine Beasts](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248311)

locations.title: The Hero's Sword
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Reach the [Master Sword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246013) through the Lost Woods, and try to pull it.  
**Steps:**
1. Through the Lost Woods and deep within the Korok Forest sleeps the sword that seals the darkness, a weapon said to be capable of striking down the Calamity.  
Though you came to claim the sword, the Deku Tree told you the blade would test you... Although you wielded it 100 years ago, can you pull the sword out in your current state?
    - Try to pull the sword with at least 13 Heart Containers to complete the quest.

**Next quest:** None

locations.title: Reach Zora's Domain
locations.description:
**Requirements:** [Seek Out Impa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248305)  
**Steps:**
1. [Sidon](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248589), prince of the Zora, invited you to come to [Zora's Domain](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247376)  
He warned you that owing to the heavy rains, the rocks along the path are dangerously slippery.
2. You arrived at Zora's Domain. The next step is to visit [King Dorephan](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248590) in the throne room on the top floor.

**Next quest:** [Divine Beast Vah Ruta](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248591)

locations.title: Divine Beast Vah Ruta
locations.description:
**Requirements:** [Reach Zora's Domain](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248588)  
**Steps:**
1. You have been asked to help appease Vah Ruta, Divine Beast of Water. The task will require a great many shock arrows.  
Find [Muzu](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248592) in Zora's Domain square to find out where to get them.
2. You asked Muzu where to get the arrows, but he refuses to help because you're a Hylian. However, he seems willing to cooperate if you can somehow prove that you were special to Mipha.
You have the [Zora Armor](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248594) that Mipha made for you. Maybe it will be proof enough.
    - Wear the Zora Armor while talking to him.
3. According to Muzu, you can get shock arrows from Ploymus Mountain.  
Wearing the Zora armor allows you to swim up waterfalls, so swimming up the waterfall east of Zora's Domain will make for a nice shortcut.  
First, you'll need to collect 20 shock arrows.
    - _Editor's Note:_ Defeating the [Lynel](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248593) has a chance to drop Shock Arrows. Otherwise, there are plenty scattered across the mountain; use the 'Arrow Chest' category for the exact locations.
4. You collected the 20 shock arrows you'll need to face the Divine Beast. Now head to East Reservoir Lake and meet with [Sidon](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248595).  
The lake is directly below Shatterback Point, the peak of Ploymus Mountain.
5. You met up with Sidon at East Reservoir Lake and are ready to put those shock arrows to use. Their electricity can activate the devices on [Divine Beast Vah Ruta](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246014)'s back.
6. You activated the devices on 's back, halting its barrage.  
Now's your chance. Head inside and take back the Divine Beast!
7. You defeated Waterblight Ganon, which had taken control of Divine Beast Vah Ruta.  
Divine Beast Vah Ruta has been enshrined to the west of Lanayru Great Spring.  
Return to Zora's Domain and report to King Dorephan.

**Next quest:** [Free the Divine Beasts](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248311)

locations.title: Forbidden City Entry
locations.description:
**Requirements:** [Seek Out Impa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248305)  
**Steps:**
1. You heard of [a man](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248642) at the Kara Kara Bazaar who found a way to sneak into Gerudo Town, a place men are forbidden from entering.  
Try and locate some people who know his whereabouts.
    - Purchase the [Gerudo Veil](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248648), [Gerudo Top](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248649) and [Gerudo Sirwal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248650) for 600 Rupees as a set.
2. You were able to find the man who snuck into Gerudo Town, and you got a Gerudo outfit from him.  
Put that on and you'll be able to pass for a woman while you're wearing it...

**Next quest:** [Divine Beast Vah Naboris](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248651)

locations.title: Divine Beast Vah Naboris
locations.description:
**Requirements:** [Forbidden City Entry](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248641)  
**Steps:**
1. The leader of the Gerudo, Lady [Riju](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247297), asked for your help in conquering Divine Beast Vah Naboris. 
Before you can confront the Divine Beast, the Gerudo need help recovering the chief's heriloom, which has been stolen. Captain [Teake](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248652) in the solders' barracks has the latest information on the thieves.
2. After speaking with Captain Teake, you learned that the thieves are hiding out in Karusa Valley, but the hideout itself has not been scouted by any of the soldiers.  
Gather additional information from the soldiers, and then head for the [thieves' hideout](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246588).
3. You've arrived in the thieves' hideout! You can sense many people waiting within—you would be at a disadvantage if a fight were to break out.  
Sneak into the hideout, and recover the [Gerudo chief's heirloom](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244844).
4. You retrieved the chief's heirloom from the thieves' leader!  
It's time to head back to Gerudo Town and return the heirloom to Riju!
5. At last you are ready to take on the Divine Beast Vah Naboris. Head for the lookout post where [Riju](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248653) is waiting for you.  
Riju has told you that a fight with the [Divine Beast](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246016) will go much more smoothly for one who knows how to sand-seal surf.
6. You defeated the Thunderblight Ganon lurking deep within the Divine Beast Vah Naboris!  
Urbosa's Divine Beast Vah Naboris has taken up a position in the eastern region of the Gerudo Desert.  
Make your way back to Gerudo Town, and report to the chief of the Gerudo, Riju!

**Next quest:** [Free the Divine Beasts](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248311)

locations.title: Find the Fairy Fountain
locations.description:
**Requirements:** [Locked Mementos](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248308)  
**Steps:**
1. [Pikango](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=237724) really wants to see the entrancing [Great Fairy Fountain](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246338) behind Kakariko Village, but all of his efforts to search for it have been stymied.  
If you find the fountain, surely Pikango would appreciate proof of its location.

**Next quest:** [Captured Memories](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248310)

locations.title: The Shrine of Resurrection
locations.description: When the game begins, a distant voice will bid Link to open his eyes. Link will awaken in a mysterious chamber from a platform that drains as he wakes. Inspecting the pedestal, you'll find the Sheikah Slate. This important tool has a lot of features that you'll become accustomed to over time.

locations.title: EX The Champions' Ballad
locations.description:
**Requirements:** The Champions' Ballad DLC , completed each of the Divine Beasts and defeated the Blight Ganons inside
**Steps:**
1. Once you have completed these main quests, Zelda will speak to you, and urge you to return to the Shrine of Resurrection where you first began the game, and place the Sheikah Slate back onto the pedestal where you initially found it.
2. Get the One-Hit Obliterator and complete the trials at the four target destinations

locations.title: EX Champion Mipha's Song
locations.description:
**Requirements:** The Champions' Ballad DLC, completed each of the Divine Beasts and defeated the Blight Ganons inside.

**Steps:**
1. Cross the Rutala Dam and climb up to find Kass already at the pedestal.
2. On the pedestal, the three obelisks reveal map locations of the shrines you must uncover and complete - which you can do in any order. All three of them are in the nearby area of the Lanayru Region.

locations.title: EX Champion Daruk's Song
locations.description:
**Requirements:** The Champions' Ballad DLC, completed each of the Divine Beasts and defeated the Blight Ganons inside.

**Steps:**
1. Talk to Kass
2. On the pedestal, the three obelisks reveal map locations of the shrines you must uncover and complete - which you can do in any order. All three of them are in the nearby area of the Eldin Region.

locations.title: EX Champion Revali's Song
locations.description:
**Requirements:** The Champions' Ballad DLC, completed each of the Divine Beasts and defeated the Blight Ganons inside.  

**Steps:**
1. Cross Lake Totori and climb up to find Kass already at the pedestal - who is trying to complete the song of his old teacher.
2. On the pedestal, the three obelisks reveal map locations of the shrines you must uncover and complete - which you can do in any order. All three of them are in the nearby area of the Tabantha and Hebra Regions.

locations.title: EX Champion Urbosa's Song
locations.description:
**Requirements:** The Champions' Ballad DLC, completed each of the Divine Beasts and defeated the Blight Ganons inside.  

**Steps:**
1. You can find the newly arisen pedestal at East Gerudo Mesa, located not far South from the Divine Beast Naboris and up the mountains to the North of Suma Sahma Shrine.
2. On the pedestal, the three obelisks reveal map locations of the shrines you must uncover and complete - which you can do in any order. All three of them are in the nearby area of the Wasteland and Gerudo Highlands Region.

locations.title: The Divine Trial
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Champions' Ballad DLC, completed each of the Divine Beasts and defeated the Blight Ganons inside.

 Upon entering the Shrine of Resurrection, place the Sheikah Slate once more in the slot, and a surprise elevator will descend the entire shrine down into a labyrinth designed by the Monk Maz Koshia - who has tasked you with solving this last giant test.

locations.title: A Premonition
locations.description: Recovered Memory #8

locations.title: Revali's Flap
locations.description: This memory - not attached to Princess Zelda - can be obtained during the [Divine Beast Vah Medoh](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248323) quest. After speaking to the Elder of Rito Village, talk to Teba's wife in the next building who will point out the landing platform. This will trigger Link's memory of the champion Revali.

locations.title: Daruk's Mettle
locations.description: This memory - not attached to Princess Zelda, can be obtained during the main quest - Divine Beast Vah Rudania. After speaking with the boss of the village, Bludo, he'll point out the large carving of the champion built into the walls above Goron City. Seeing this will trigger a memory of Link's time with the Goron Champion.

locations.title: Urbosa's Hand
locations.description: This memory - not attatched to Princess Zelda, can be found during the main quest - Divine Beast Vah Naboris. Once you've infiltrated Gerudo Town and spoken to the chief, Riju, get the Thunder Helm back from the Yiga Clan, and giving it back to Riju will trigger a memory of Link's time with the Gerudo Champion, Urbosa.

locations.title: Mipha's Touch
locations.description: This memory - not attached to Princess Zelda, is found during part of the Main Quest, Divine Beast Vah Ruta. After speaking with the Zora King, head down to the lower level to talk to Muzu, who will point out the statue of Mipha. Seeing it will cause Link to remember a memory of his time with Mipha, the Zora Champion.

locations.title: The Master Sword
locations.description: The last memory, while attached to Princess Zelda, has no picture in the Sheikah Slate album, and is instead part of the Main Quest - The Hero's Sword. Once you have located the Master Sword, you will need to successfully pull out the sword - which requires a minimum of 13 Heart Containers. Doing so will cause Link to see the final memory.

locations.title: Watch Out for the Flowers
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Magda](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246603)  
**Solution:** Reach the entrance of the [Hila Rao Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225220) without stepping on the flowers; instead, navigate through the cleared areas. Stepping on a flower will reset Link's position to Magda.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Hila Rao Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225220).

locations.title: The Stolen Heirloom
locations.description:
**Requirements:**
- Find the Fairy Fountain
- Flown the Coop
- By Firefly's Light
  
**How to start:** Speak with [Paya](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246614)  
**Solution:**
1. Wait until 22:00 by sitting at the bonfire outside.
2. Stealthily follow [Dorian](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246616) up to the [Lakna Rokee Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225156).
3. Defeat the [Yiga Blademaster](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225275).
4. Place the heirloom into the pedestal.

**Reward:** Unlocks the [Lakna Rokee Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225156)

locations.title: The Crowned Beast
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Kass](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246620)  
**Solution:** Find a [Mountain Buck](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=7772) and ride it to the pedestal near Kass.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Mezza Lo Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225160)

locations.title: Secret of the Cedars
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Clavia](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246624)  
**Solution:** Head to [Tahno O'ah Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225263), and reveal it by bombing the cracked wall there.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Tahno O'ah Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225263).

locations.title: The Spring of Wisdom
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Medda](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246628)  
**Solution:**
1. Go to the [Spring of Wisdom](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246489).
2. Shoot all 4 large Malice Eyes over Naydra's body. Use the nearby updrafts and high peaks to get different vantage points.
3. Shoot Naydra one last time.
4. Pick up Naydra's Scale, then drop it in the spring.

**Reward:** Unlocks the [Jitan Sa'mi Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225256)

locations.title: The Cursed Statue
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Calip](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246634)  
**Solution:** Go near [Kam Urog Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225161), and shoot an arrow at the statue with glowing eyes.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Kam Urog Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225161)

locations.title: Master of the Wind
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Kass](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246652)  
**Solution:** Clear the large rock formation of the debris blocking the wind currents. There are 4 debris to blow up, using either bombs or Bomb arrows. Once cleared, climb on top of the formation and glide along the wind current onto the pedestal.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Shai Yota Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225169)

locations.title: The Ceremonial Song
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Laruta](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246655)  
**Solution:** Retrieve the [Ceremonial Trident](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245744). Then, go to [Veiled Falls](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246471). Gain some height, either by swimming up the waterfall or climbing a nearby cliff, and glide down towards the pedestal. Finally, when just above it, attack with the Trident to reveal the shrine.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Dagah Keek Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225163)

locations.title: A Song of Storms
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Kass](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246661)  
**Solution:** Get lightning to strike the mound at the shrine. During a thunderstorm, you can:
- Wear a metal weapon or armor, and get struck by lightning;
- Wear the [Thunder Helm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247295) to avoid taking damage;
- Drop a metal weapon on top of mound. As lightning is about to strike, paraglide away to avoid damage.

**Reward:** Unlocks the [Qukah Nata Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225249)

locations.title: A Fragmented Monument
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Garini](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246665)  
**Solution:** Take pictures of the three lost fragments ([#1](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246667), [#2](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246668) and [#3](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246669)) and bring them back to Garini. Then, crouch on either pedestals to reveal the shrine.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Kah Yah Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225166)

locations.title: The Three Giant Brothers
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Read the stone tablet  
**Solution:** Bring the three glowing balls in the pedestals around the stone tablet. The balls are around the necks of the nearby Hinox brothers ([the youngest](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225309); [the middle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225316); [the oldest](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225332)). You may either defeat them, or simple steal the balls.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Tawa Jinn Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225162)

locations.title: Stranded on Eventide
locations.description:
**Requirements:** The ability to reach Eventide island (at least 2 stamina wheels to paraglide from [Cape Cales](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246509))  
**How to start:** Step on [Eventide Island](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246547). Be careful; you will be stripped of all your gear, including your inventory.  
**Solution:** Bring the three glowing orbs ([#1](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246674), [#2](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246676), [#3](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246678)) to the three altars ([#1](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246675), [#2](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246677), [#3](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246679)), in any combination.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Korgu Chideh Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225170)

locations.title: The Serpent's Jaws
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Kass](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246685)  
**Solution:** Drop a Farosh's Scale in the [Spring of Courage](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246282).  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Shae Katha Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225224)

locations.title: Guardian Slideshow
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Loone](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246693)  
**Solution:** Take pictures of a Guardian Stalker, a Guardian Skywatcher and a Guardian Scout. Use the "Search" bar to find each type of guardian. Then, take the Ancient Orb and place it on the pedestal.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Shoqa Tatone Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225155)

locations.title: The Eye of the Sandstorm
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Nobiro](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246878)  
**Solution:** Go to the shrine between 9:00 PM and 4:00 AM.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Dako Tah Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225184)

locations.title: Secret of the Snowy Peaks
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Read the [Mountain Peak Log](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=239015)  
**Solution:** Grab the largest snowball in the nearby ponds. Then, stand at the edge of the cliff, facing the [Pedestal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246889), between 16:30 and 17:30. The snowball should cast a shadow on the center of the pedestal, revealing the shrine.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Suma Sahma Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225148)

locations.title: The Silent Swordswomen
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Laine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246892)  
**Solution:** Follow the trail of statues to the shrine.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Kema Zoos Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225176)

locations.title: The Undefeated Champ
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Shabonne](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246895)  
**Solution:** Win [Sand-Seal Racing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246896) under 1:30.00. Then, place the trophy in the pedestal to reveal the shrine.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Raqa Zunzo Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225138)

locations.title: The Desert Labyrinth
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Enter the [South Lomei Labyrinth](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246185)  
**Solution:** Reach the center of the maze; see the attached screenshot for the solution.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Dila Maag Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225205)

locations.title: The Seven Heroines
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Rotana](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246908)  
**Solution:** Go to the [East Gerudo Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246141), and gather the six scattered Glowing Orbs ([#1](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246910), [#2](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246911), [#3](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246912), [#4](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246913), [#5](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246914), [#6](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246915)) in the center. Then, place the orbs in the pedestals, so their symbol matches the statue behind it. From the entrance, going clockwise, the order is:
- Comma (,)
- Carrot (^)
- O
- Colon (:)
- S
- Tear
- II (already in place)

**Reward:** Unlocks the [Korsh O'hu Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225144)

locations.title: The Perfect Drink
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Pokki](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246917)  
**Solution:** Speak with [Furosa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246919) about the drink, then speak with [Anshe](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246921) at the icehouse during the day. Finally, carry the block of ice from the icehouse to [Furosa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246920) at the entrance of the ruins. Stay in the shade as much as possible.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Misae Suma Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225194)

locations.title: Cliffside Etchings
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Geggle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246927)  
**Solution:** At the shrine, shoot the pedestal with a Shock Arrow to reveal it.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Keeha Yoog Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225134)

locations.title: Test of Will
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Bayge](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246931)  
**Solution:** The Gorons will challenge Link to two endurance challenges. The shrine will reveal itself after the second challenge.
1. Outlast the Gorons in Heat. Simply gain Heat Resistance or Flame Guard from food or equipment.
2. Outlast the Gorons in Heat and Fire, without equipment. This time, you need to gain Fireproof from a Fireproof Elixir. Otherwise, simply eat food as Link gets damaged until the Gorons pass out.  

**Reward:** Unlocks the [Joloo Nah Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225143)

locations.title: Sign of the Shadow
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Kass](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246935)  
**Solution:** Stand on the pedestal in front of the shrine. At 15:00, the pedestal will light up; shoot an arrow at the sun to reveal the shrine.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Sasa Kai Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225135)

locations.title: Trial of Thunder
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Enter the [Thundra Plateau](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246123)  
**Solution:** Find the orbs scattered around the plateau ([Red Orb](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247008); [Green Orb](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247010); [Purple Orb](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247009); [Orange Orb](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247011)), and place them in the corresponding pedestals.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Toh Yahsa Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225141)

locations.title: Under a Red Moon
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Kass](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247014)  
**Solution:** Stand on the pedestal during a Blood Moon, without any weapon or equipment, to reveal the shrine.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Mijah Rokee Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225142)

locations.title: The Two Rings
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Kass](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247021)  
**Solution:** Move to this position, and shoot an arrow through both stone rings. See the screenshot for reference.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Sheem Dagoze Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225146)

locations.title: The Ancient Rito Song
locations.description:
**Requirements:** [Divine Beast Vah Medoh](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248323)  
**How to start:** Speak with [Bedoli](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247031)  
**Solution:** Between 12:30 and 13:30, light a fire atop the pedestal just north of the shrine. Alternatively, stand on it with a lit torch.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Bareeda Naag Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225132)

locations.title: Recital at Warbler's Nest
Trial on the Cliff
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Enter the [North Lomei Labyrinth](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246186)  
**Solution:** Reach the center of the maze; see the attached screenshot for the solution, following the orange path and backtracking along the green path.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Qaza Tokki Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225206)

locations.title: The Bird in the Mountains
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Molli](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247063)  
**Solution:** Head to the [Lone Cedar Tree](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247065). From there, paraglide towards the shrine; you should see it as you approach.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Mozo Shenno Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225179)

locations.title: Shrouded Shrine
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Walk to the marker.  
**Solution:** Use the torch to light up the bird statue, then follow the direction of its beak. Repeat this from statue to statue until you reach the [Blue Hinox](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225324). Get the orb from its neck (either defeat him or steal the orb), and place it in the [Pedestal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247096) to reveal the shrine.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Ketoh Wawai Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225153)

locations.title: The Lost Pilgrimage
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Tasho](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247100)  
**Solution:** Follow [Oaki](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247102) without him seeing you, all the way to the shrine. Stay at a distance and don't move when he turns around.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Daag Chokah Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225207)

locations.title: Trial of Second Sight
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Zooki](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247104)  
**Solution:**
1. Using Magnesis, spot the trees holding iron in their branches.
2. Walk from tree to tree to lead you to the [Rusty Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245485).
3. Magnesis the shield in the tree behind the torches; doing so will spawn a [Treasure Chest containing Amber](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244490).
4. Magnesis the chest on the nearby raft, grab a Korok Leaf and move it to the island in the center of the pond.
5. Drop the chest in the tree to spawn the shrine.
  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Kuhn Sidajj Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225154)

locations.title: The Test of Wood
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Damia](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247107)  
**Solution:** Reach the shrine, using only the given pieces of equipment. If any break (by usage or contact with a Fire enemy) or dropped (by contact with an Electric enemy), the trial is failed.
- [Forest Dweller's Sword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245899)
- [Forest Dweller's Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245510)
- [Forest Dweller's Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245097)

**Reward:** Unlocks the [Maag Halan Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225217)

locations.title: Into the Vortex
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Read the stone slab.  
**Solution:** Carry the nearby orb all the way to the shrine.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Ritaag Zumo Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225167)

locations.title: The Spring of Power
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Nobo](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247118)  
**Solution:** Interact with the statue at the [Spring of Power](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246449). Then, drop a Dinraal's Scale in the pond to reveal the shrine.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Tutsuwa Nima Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225251)

locations.title: The Skull's Eye
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Jerrin](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247122)  
**Solution:** Simply get to the shrine. Climbing gear and high stamina are recommended.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Zuna Kai Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225250)

locations.title: Trial of the Labyrinth
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Set foot on [Lomei Labyrinth Island](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246516)  
**Solution:** Navigate to the center of the maze; see the attached screenshot for reference.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Tu Ka'loh Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225259)

locations.title: A Brother's Roast
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Bladon](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247158)  
**Solution:** Speak with [Gonguron](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247160) in the tunnel. Then, bring him a [Rock Roast](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247161) to have him open the way to the shrine.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Kayra Mah Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225242)

locations.title: The Gut Check Challenge
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Bayge](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247163)  
**Solution:** Complete the [Gut Check Rock Challenge](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247165), with a reduced entry fee of 20 Rupees.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Gorae Torr Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225240)

locations.title: Find Kheel
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Divine Beast Vah Medoh  
**How to start:** Speak with [Amali](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247038)  
**Walkthrough:** Speak with [Kheel](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247040), then with Amali to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** Purple Rupee

locations.title: A Landscape of a Stable
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Mayro](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247166)  
**Solution:** Reach the shrine to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** Unlocks the [Tah Muhl Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225245)

locations.title: Misko, the Great Bandit
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak to either [Prissen](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247169) or [Domidak](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247170) twice and pay them 100 Rupees.  
**Walkthrough:** Open any chest in [Misko's Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247172) to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** The contents of the cave.

locations.title: The Priceless Maracas
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Hestu](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247173)  
**Walkthrough:** Bring [Hestu's Maracas](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=243862) back to him.  
**Reward:** Unlocks Hestu's inventory upgrades.

locations.title: Wild Horses
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Rensa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247175)  
**Walkthrough:** Tame and bring a wild horse back to Rensa within 2 minutes. Look just north of the stable.  
**Reward:** Purple Rupee

locations.title: Flown the Coop
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Cado](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247177)  
**Walkthrough:** Find the seven scattered Cuccos around the village and bring them back in the pen:
- [Cucco #1](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=224224)
- [Cucco #2](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=224225)
- [Cucco #3](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=224226)
- [Cucco #4](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=224227)
- [Cucco #5](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=224230)
- [Cucco #6](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=224232)
- [Cucco #7](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=224233)

**Reward:** Purple Rupee

locations.title: Arrows of Burning Heat
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Rola](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=221290)  
**Walkthrough:** Using a bow, light all four torches surrounding the [Goddess Statue](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245040). Use other torches or campfires to set normal arrows alight.  
**Reward:** Red Rupee

locations.title: Koko's Kitchen
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Koko](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247180)  
**Walkthrough:** Bring Koko a Swift Carrot. If you have none, you can purchase one at [High Spirits Produce](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=221286).  
**Reward:** Hasty Veggie Cream Soup

locations.title: Cooking with Koko
locations.description:
**Requirements:** [Koko's Kitchen](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247181)  
**How to start:** Speak with [Koko](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247180)  
**Walkthrough:** Bring Koko some Goat Butter. If you have none, you can purchase some at [High Spirits Produce](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=221286).  
**Reward:** Hot Buttered Apples

locations.title: Koko Cuisine
locations.description:
**Requirements:** [Cooking with Koko](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247182)  
**How to start:** Speak with [Koko](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247180)  
**Walkthrough:** Bring Koko some Raw Meat.  
**Reward:** Tough Meat-Stuffed Pumpkin

locations.title: Koko's Specialty
locations.description:
**Requirements:** [Koko Cuisine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247183)  
**How to start:** Speak with [Koko](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247180)  
**Walkthrough:** Bring Koko some Courser Bee Honey. If you have none, head to any large forest (such as the [Forest of Spirits](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246218)) and destroy a beehive.  
**Reward:** Energizing Honeyed Apple

locations.title: Playtime with Cottla
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None
