**How to start:** Speak with [Cottla](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247185) between 11:00 and 17:00.  
**Walkthrough:** Depends on your choice of game:
- Hide-and-seek: Wait for Cottla to hide, and go to [Cottla's Hiding Spot](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247187).
- Tag: Run after Cottla, and sprint when near to her to catch her.

**Reward:** Rock Salt

locations.title: By Firefly's Light
locations.description:
**Requirements:**
- Locked Mementos
- Find the Fairy Fountain
- [Flown the Coop](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247178)

**How to start:** Speak with [Lasli](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247188), at night.  
**Walkthrough:** Bring five [Sunset Firefly](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=7833) and release them in Lasli's house.  
**Reward:** Purple Rupee

locations.title: The Statue's Bargain
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with the [Horned Statue](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247190); you lose either a Heart Container or a Stamina Vessel upon doing so.  
**Walkthrough:** Speak with the statue again and choose to gain either a Heart Container or a Stamina Vessel to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** Horned Statue's exchange service.

locations.title: The Weapon Connoisseur
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Nebb](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247192)  
**Walkthrough:** Show Nebb the weapon he seeks; he will give Link a reward and another weapon. Use the search bar on the left for the locations of a specific weapon.  
**Weapons and rewards:**
- Traveler's Sword: Red Rupee
- Fire Rod: Red Rupee
- Moblin Club: Purple Rupee
- Duplex Bow: Purple Rupee
- Windcleaver: Silver Rupee
- Ancient Battle Axe+: Silver Rupee
- Frostspear: Gold Rupee
- Ancient Short Sword: [Diamond](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247194)

locations.title: A Gift for My Beloved
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Manny](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247195).  
**Walkthrough:** Speak with [Prima](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247197), then with Manny again. Bring him 10 [Restless Cricket](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=7832) to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** Silver Rupee

locations.title: The Sheep Rustlers
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Koyin](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247198)  
**Walkthrough:** Complete the [Enemy Camp](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247200) at Hateno Beach.  
**Reward:** 10x Fresh Milk

locations.title: Robbie's Research
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Locked Mementos  
**How to start:** Speak with [Purah](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247204)  
**Walkthrough:**
1. Head to the [Akkala Ancient Tech Lab](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247202).
2. Speak with [Cherry](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247201) inside.
3. Remove your body armor, then speak with Robbie.
4. Head to the [Ancient Furnace](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247206) with a Torch. Light it with the furnace's blue flame.
5. Bring the blue flame back to the lab. See the screenshot for a reference path. Light the stone lanterns along the way so you can safely drop the torch to fight if needed.
6. Light the brazier in front of the lab to complete the quest.

**Reward:** Unlocks the Akkala Ancient Tech Lab's shop.

locations.title: Slated for Upgrades
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Locked Mementos  
**How to start:** Speak with [Purah](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247204)  
**Walkthrough:** Upgrade the three following runes in your Sheikah slate:
- Stasis → Stasis+ (3x Ancient Core): Allows Stasis to also freeze enemies.
- Remote Bomb → Remote Bomb+ (3x Ancient Shaft): Increses the blast radius while reducing the cooldown.
- Sheikah Sensor → Sheikah Sensor+ (3x Ancient Screw): Allows the Sensor to track Compendium items instead of Ancient Shrines.

**Reward:** The above rune upgrades.

locations.title: Sunshroom Sensing
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Sheikah Sensor+ (acquired during [Slated for Upgrades](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247218))  
**How to start:** Speak with [Symin](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247219)  
**Walkthrough:** Bring Symin a picture of a Sunshroom (she suggests [this one](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=230628)). Then, using the Sensor+, find three more [Sunshroom](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=6888) and bring them to Symin.  
**Reward:** 3x Hearty Truffle

locations.title: The Hero's Cache
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Kass](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247221)  
**Walkthrough:** Grab the [Treasure Chest](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244205) from the water and open it to complete the quest.    
**Reward:** The Gold Rupee inside the chest.

locations.title: Hylian Homeowner
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Bolson](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247223)  
**Walkthrough:** Gather 30 bundles of wood (use axes or bombs on fell trees) and 3,000 Rupees and give them to Bolson. Speak to [Hudson](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247225) to start [From the Ground Up](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247226), then speak with Bolson again. Finally, purchase all 14 available house upgrades at 100 Rupees apiece to complete the quest:
- Gear displays (store a piece of gear ouside of Link's inventory):
    - 2x Weapon display
    - 3x Bow display
    - 3x Shield display
- Bed (heals Link while passing time)
- Cosmetics: Door, Lighting, Sign with Link's Name, Flowers and Trees.
  
**Reward:** The house.

locations.title: From the Ground Up
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Link's House (acquired during [Hylian Homeowner](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247224))  
**How to start:** Speak with [Hudson](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247225)  
**Walkthrough:**
1. Speak with [Hudson](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247227) in the Akkala region.
2. Hudson will first ask for some bundles of wood, then for a specific individual. Speak to that individual to bring them to the village, which will unlock a new building. Do this process four times:
    - Bring 10 bundles of wood, then get [Greyson](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247421) to open [Ore and More](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247422)
    - Bring 20 bundles of wood, then get [Rhondson](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247427) to open [Rhondson Armor Boutique](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247428)
    - Bring 30 bundles of wood, then get [Fyson](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247424) to open [Slippery Falcon (Tarrey Town Branch)](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247425)
    - Bring 50 bundles of wood, then get [Kapson](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247430) to open [Tarrey Town Inn](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247431)
3. Speak with Hudson, then speak [Bolson](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247223) and head back to Tarrey Town.
4. After the cutscene, speak with Hudson to complete the quest.

**Reward:** [3x Diamond](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247228)

locations.title: Special Delivery
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Divine Beast Vah Ruta  
**How to start:** Speak with [Finley](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247229)  
**Walkthrough:** Follow and guard the container down the river, all the way to [Sasan](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247231). Stay a little ahead to clear any enemies or obstacles in the way. Speak with Sasan, then with [Finley](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247233) in Zora's Domain to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** [Gold Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247234)

locations.title: Diving is Beauty!
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Divine Beast Vah Ruta  
**How to start:** Speak with [Gruve](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247235)  
**Walkthrough:** Jump down the waterfall to dive in the basin below. Then, swim up the waterfall and speak with Gruve to complete the shrine.  
**Reward:** 5x Fleet-Lotus Seeds

locations.title: Lynel Safari
locations.description:
**Requirements:**
- Divine Beast Vah Ruta
- Locked Mementos
  
**How to start:** Speak with [Laflat](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247237)  
**Walkthrough:** Show Laflat the picture of any [Lynel](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=6846).  
**Reward:** [Zora Greaves](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247239)

locations.title: Frog Catching
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Divine Beast Vah Ruta  
**How to start:** Speak with [Tumbo](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247240)  
**Walkthrough:** Bring him five [Hot-Footed Frogs](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=7834) to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** Armoranth

locations.title: The Giant of Ralis Pond
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Divine Beast Vah Ruta  
**How to start:** Speak with [Torfeau](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247242)  
**Walkthrough:** Defeat the [Blue Hinox](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225326) by Ralis Pond, then speak with Torfeau to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** Silver Rupee

locations.title: Luminous Stone Gathering
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Divine Beast Vah Ruta  
**How to start:** Speak with [Ledo](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247244)  
**Walkthrough:** Bring him 10 [Luminous Stone](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=6873) to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** [2x Diamond](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247246), and the ability to trade Luminous Stone for Diamonds with Ledo.

locations.title: A Wife Washed Away
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Divine Beast Vah Ruta  
**How to start:** Speak with [Fronk](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247247)  
**Walkthrough:** Speak with [Mei](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247249) to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** 5x Staminoka Bass

locations.title: Riverbed Reward
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Izra](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247250)  
**Walkthrough:** Grab the [Treasure Chest](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244468) from the river and speak with Izra to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** The Knight's Broadsword inside.

locations.title: Zora Stone Monuments
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Divine Beast Vah Ruta  

**How to start:** Speak with [Jiahto](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247252)  

**Walkthrough:** Read all 10 [Zora Monuments](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=6860) in any order, then speak with Jiahto to complete the quest.  

**Reward:** [Diamond](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247254)

locations.title: What's for Dinner?
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with Kiana  
**Walkthrough:** Bring her some Goat Butter (purchasable at [High Spirits Produce](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=221286) and a Hearty Blueshell Snail ([this one](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=222910) is fairly close).  
**Reward:**
- Purple Rupee
- Seafood Paella

locations.title: Sunken Treasure
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Rozel](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247257)  
**Walkthrough:** Open all four of the chests below and speak with Rozel again to complete the quest.  
**Reward:**
- [Topaz](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=243958)
- [Topaz](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=243959)
- [Sapphire](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=243935)
- [Thunderblade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244480)

locations.title: Take Back the Sea
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Sebasto](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247259)  
**Walkthrough:** Complete the [Enemy Camp](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247261) near [Aris Beach](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246375), then speak with Sebasto to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** Silver Rupee

locations.title: A Gift of Nightshade
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Wabbin](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247262)  
**Walkthrough:** Bring a [Blue Nightshade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=6878) to [Perda](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247263).  
**Reward:** Red Rupee + Purple Rupee

locations.title: Thunder Magnet
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Cima](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247265)  
**Walkthrough:** Climb the side of the stable and remove the [Woodcutter's Axe](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245340) from the roof.  
**Reward:** [Rubber Helm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247267)

locations.title: Hunt for the Giant Horse
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Straia](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247268)  
**Walkthrough:** Capture the [Giant Horse](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225912) and bring it back to Straia.  
**Reward:** Silver Rupee

locations.title: The Horseback Hoodlums
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Perosa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247270)  
**Walkthrough:** Defeat 5 Blue Bokoblins on horseback; five such enemies wander just north, in the [Fural Plain](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246293). Speak with Perosa again to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** 1x Endura Carrot

locations.title: Good-Sized Horse
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Zyle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247272)  
**Walkthrough:** Bring Zyle any normal-sized horse.  
**Reward:** Gold Rupee

locations.title: Missing in Action
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Sesami](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=237727)  
**Walkthrough:** Save [Flaxel](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=237730), [Canolo](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=237728), [Oliff](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=237734) and [Palme](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=237732) from the Bokoblin. The four of them are on the wooden scaffoldings; either access from the cliffs around or from the start of the ramp, under Flaxel.  
**Reward:** Gold Rupee

locations.title: Rushroom Rush!
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Pirou](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247277)  
**Walkthrough:** Bring Pirou 55 [Rushroom](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=6886) to complete the shrine.   
**Reward:** [Diamond](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244843)

locations.title: An Ice Guy
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Guy](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247280)  
**Walkthrough:** Bring Guy a Chilly Elixir. Do to so, mix any monster part with either a Winterwing Butterfly or a Cold Darner in a Cooking Pot.  
**Reward:** Purple Rupee

locations.title: Tools of the Trade
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Forbidden City Entry  
**How to start:** Speak with [Isha](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247282)  
**Walkthrough:** Bring her 10 Flint to complete the quest  
**Reward:**
- One of either the [Sapphire Circlet](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247392), the [Ruby Circlet](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247391) or the [Topaz Earrings](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247396) for free;
- Access to [Starlight Memories](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247390)

locations.title: The Secret Club's Secret
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Forbidden City Entry  
**How to start:** Try a code the at Gerudo Secret Club's door.  
**Walkthrough:** Speak with either [Yaido](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247285), [Sumati](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247286) or [Pyra](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247287). Then, head to the building directly southwest and eavesdrop on them through the window. Try the right code (GSC◆) at the door to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** Access to [Gerudo Secret Club](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247389)

locations.title: Medicinal Molduga
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Forbidden City Entry  
**How to start:** Speak with [Malena](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247288)  
**Walkthrough:** Bring Malena some Molduga Guts, which are obtained by killing a Molduga.  
**Reward:** Gold Rupee

locations.title: The Eighth Heroine
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Forbidden City Entry  
**How to start:** Speak with [Bozai](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247290) while wearing the Gerudo Set.  
**Walkthrough:** Head to the [Statue of the Eighth Heroine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246044), and take picture of its head. Show it to Bozai to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** [Sand Boots](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247292)

locations.title: The Forgotten Sword
locations.description:
**Requirements:** [The Eighth Heroine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247291)  
**How to start:** Speak with [Bozai](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247290)  
**Walkthrough:** Take a picture of the giant stone sword atop [Gerudo Summit](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246058), and show it to Bozai to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** ??

locations.title: The Thunder Helm
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Divine Beast Vah Naboris  
**How to start:** Interact with the [Thunder Helm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247295)  
**Walkthrough:** Complete the four following side quests, then speak with [Riju](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247297).
- [Tools of the Trade](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247283)
- [Medicinal Molduga](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247289)
- [The Mystery Polluter](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247299)
- [The Search for Barta](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247302)

**Reward:** [Thunder Helm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247295)

locations.title: The Mystery Polluter
locations.description:
**Requirements:** 
- Divine Beast Vah Naboris
- Start [The Thunder Helm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247296)

**How to start:** Speak with [Dalia](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247298) around noon.  
**Walkthrough:** Speak with [Calyban](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247300), then bring her 10 [Wildberry](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=7745). Speak with Dalia to complete the quest.  
**Reward:**
- 1x Hydromelon
- Wildberry bushes

locations.title: The Search for Barta
locations.description:
**Requirements:**
- Divine Beast Vah Naboris
- Start [The Thunder Helm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247296)

**How to start:** Speak with [Liana](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247301)  
**Walkthrough:** Bring a Hearty Durian to [Barta](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247303), then speak with Liana to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** Silver Rupee

locations.title: Curry for What Ails You
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Lester](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247304)  
**Walkthrough:** Bring Lester some Goron Spice, which you can get from [Goron Gusto Shop](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247378)  
**Reward:** Purple Rupee

locations.title: The Apple of my Eye
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Juney](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246590)  
**Walkthrough:** Bring a Baked Apple (an apple thrown on a campfire) to Juney to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** Silver Rupee

locations.title: The Spark of Romance
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Jogo](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246589)  
**Walkthrough:** Bring a piece of Flint to Jogo to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** Silver Rupee

locations.title: Face the Frost Talus
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Divine Beast Vah Medoh  
**How to start:** Speak with [Gesane](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247308)  
**Walkthrough:** Defeat the [Frost Talus](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225346) and return to Gesane to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** Silver Rupee

locations.title: Stalhorse: Pictured!
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Locked Mementos  
**How to start:** Speak with [Juannelle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247310)  
**Walkthrough:** Bring Juannelle a picture of either [Stalhorse](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225913)/[Stalhorse](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225914) to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** Silver Rupee

locations.title: Balloon Flight
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Shamae](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247312)  
**Walkthrough:** Use 2 Octo Balloons (drops from Octoroks) on the barrel to make it fly and complete the quest.  
**Reward:** 1x Star Fragment

locations.title: A Freezing Rod
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Start The Hero's Sword  
**How to start:** Speak with [Kula](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247314)  
**Walkthrough:** Bring back either an Ice Rod or a Blizzard Rod to Kula to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** Silver Rupee (for an Ice Rod) or Gold Rupee (for a Blizzard Rod)

locations.title: The Korok Trials
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Start The Hero's Sword  
**How to start:** Speak with [Chio](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247316)  
**Walkthrough:** Complete the following three Shrine Quests:
- [Trial of Second Sight](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247105)
- [The Lost Pilgrimage](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247101)
- [The Trial of Wood](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247108)
  
**Reward:** 3x Hearty Truffle

locations.title: Legendary Rabbit Trial
locations.description:
**Requirements:**
- Locked Mementos
- Start The Hero's Sword
- Start [The Priceless Maracas](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247174)

**How to start:** Speak with [Peeks](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247318)  
**Walkthrough:** Bring Peeks a picture of a [Blupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=6835) to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** Silver Rupee

locations.title: Leviathan Bones
A Gift from the Monks
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Complete the 120 non-DLC shrines  
**How to start:** Automatic upon completion of the last shrine  
**Walkthrough:** Open the three following chests to complete the quest.  
**Reward:**
- [Cap of the Wild](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244840)
- [Tunic of the Wild](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244842)
- [Trousers of the Wild](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244841)

locations.title: Riddles of Hyrule
A Gift for the Great Fairy
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Toren](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247328)  
**Walkthrough:** Speak with [Great Fairy Kayasa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246037), then speak with Toren again to complete the shrine.  
**Reward:** 500 Rupees

locations.title: The Royal Guard's Gear
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Parcy](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247330)  
**Walkthrough:** Show Parcy any Royal Guard weapon, or a Royal Guard Shield, to complete the quest. Use the search bar on the left to see their locations.  
**Reward:** Gold Rupee

locations.title: A Rare Find
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Trott](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247332)  
**Walkthrough:** Bring Trott a piece of Raw Gourmet Meat. Most mammals have about 10% chance to drop some; see individual categories for specific drop rates and categories.  
**Reward:** Silver Rupee

locations.title: My Hero
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Aliza](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247335)  
**Walkthrough:** Complete The Hero's Sword and show Aliza the [Master Sword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246013) to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** 1x Star Fragment

locations.title: A Royal Recipe
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Gotter](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247337)  
**Walkthrough:** Make Gotter either of the recipes found in Hyrule Castle's Library. You do not have to read the recipes, you can just make them:
- [Fruitcake](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245056): Fruit, Fruit, Tabantha Wheat, Cane Sugar
- [Monster Cake](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245057): Monster Extract, Tabantha Wheat, Cane Sugar, Goat Butter

**Reward:** Silver Rupee. If you make the other recipe, you will gain another Silver Rupee.

locations.title: The Royal White Stallion
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Toffa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247339)  
**Walkthrough:** Bring the [White Horse](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225916) to Toffa.  
**Reward:**
- [Royal Saddle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247341)
- [Royal Bridle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247342)

locations.title: Fireproof Lizard Roundup
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Kima](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247343)  
**Walkthrough:** Bring 10 [Fireproof Lizard](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?catIds=7838) to Kima to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** [Flamebreaker Armor](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247345)

locations.title: The Road to Respect
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Fugo](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247346)  
**Walkthrough:** Defeat the [Igneo Talus](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225339) near [Darunia Lake](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246309) to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** Silver Rupee

locations.title: Death Mountain's Secret
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Speak with [Dugby](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247348)  
**Walkthrough:** Show the [Drillshaft](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245729) to Dugby to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** The Drillshaft.

locations.title: The Jewel Trade
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Divine Beast Vah Rudania  
**How to start:** Speak with [Ramella](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247350)  
**Walkthrough:** Bring 10 Amber to Ramella to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** 500 Rupees

locations.title: A Parent's Love
locations.description:
**Requirements:** [From the Ground Up](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247226)  
**How to start:** Eavesdrop a conversation between [Ruli](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247352) and [Hagie](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247354) from their window, around 21:00.  
**Walkthrough:** Give a Monster Cake (Monster Extract, Tabantha Wheat, Goat Butter, Cane Sugar) to Ruli, then speak her again to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** Gold Rupee

locations.title: Hobbies of the Rich
locations.description:
**Requirements:** [From the Ground Up](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247226)  
**How to start:** Speak with [Hagie](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247354)  
**Walkthrough:** Defeat both Guardian Stalkers in the [Torin Wetlands](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=246455) ([here](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225686) and [here](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=225687))  
**Reward:** Silver Rupee + Red Rupee

locations.title: A Shady Customer
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Locked Mementos  
**How to start:** Speak with [Hoz](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247356)  
**Walkthrough:** Show Hoz a picture of Kilton, the owner of Fang and Bone.  
**Reward:** Silver Rupee

locations.title: Little Sister's Big Request
locations.description:
**Requirements:** None  
**How to start:** Give an Armoranth to [Jana](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247358)  
**Walkthrough:** Speak with [Gleema](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247360), then bring Jana a Warm Darner, a Cold Darner and an Electric Darner. Then, speak to Gleema, then Jana to complete the quest.  
**Reward:** Silver Rupee

locations.title: EX Royal Guard Rumors
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Complete [The Isolated Plateau](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248304)  
**How to start:** Automatic  
**Walkthrough:** Read [Super Rumor Mill V4](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=245067), then open the chests in the rewards to complete the quest.  
**Reward:**
- [Royal Guard Cap](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244520)
- [Royal Guard Uniform](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244522)
- [Royal Guard Boots](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244521)

**Note:** Part of the Expansion Pass DLC

locations.title: EX Ancient Horse Rumors
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Champions' Ballad DLC  
**How to start:** Find the new journal - Super Rumor Mill EX: Volume 3 - inside the Highland Stable.
**Walkthrough:** You can find the Ancient Bridle at the base of the large tree at the top of Satori Mountain - look for the distinctive pink petals that adorn the tree and surround the ground. Use Magnesis to pull the embedded chest out of the ground to claim it.  
**Reward:** Ancient Bridle

locations.title: EX Treasure: Merchant Hood
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Champions' Ballad DLC  
**How to start:** The Quest is located at the Deya Village Ruins, located in the Lake Region to the Southwest of the Dueling Peaks Tower.  
**Walkthrough:** Find the clue and then travel to the Spring of Courage where Shae Katha Shrine is found. Climb up the platform that the stone claw is clutching and look under the claws with the Magnesis Rune to find a buried chest holding Ravio's Hood.
**Reward:** Ravio's Hood

locations.title: EX Treasure: Usurper King
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Champions' Ballad   
**How to start:** Travel to the flooded ruins of the Deya Village and look for a large destroyed house with its foundation intact - near a broken wagon. Inside the house is a new journal from Misko the Great Bandit.  
**Walkthrough:** Head to Tobio's Hollow, to the South of the Dueling Peaks where a Hinox sleeps. North of this valley is a swampy pool - and if you carefully glide down to the island in the top left, you can find a buried chest containing Zant's Helmet.
**Reward:** Zant's Helmet

locations.title: EX Treasure: Garb of the Winds
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Champions' Ballad DLC  
**How to start:** Travel to the flooded ruins of the Deya Village and look for a large destroyed house with its foundation intact - near a broken wagon. Inside the house is a new journal from Misko the Great Bandit.
**Walkthrough:** Head to Cora Lake, and look at the motion of the water to find where the source is coming from off on the West. Once you get to the last few rocks in front of the source, use Magnesis to check the waters below to find the chest holding the Island Lobster Shirt (create a platform with Cryonis to get close to the chest). 
**Reward:** Island Lobster Shirt

locations.title: EX Treasure: Dark Armor
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Champions' Ballad DLC
**How to start:** Travel to the flooded ruins of the Deya Village and look for a large destroyed house with its foundation intact - near a broken wagon. 
**Walkthrough:** To find the chest piece, head to the Faron Tower, and glide down to the West towards the Sarjon Woods. Make for the Sarjon Bridge between the two small waterfalls. Jump onto the rocks under the bridge and use Magnesis to pull a chest up containing the Phantom Ganon Armor.
**Reward:** Phantom Ganon armor set

locations.title: EX Strange Mask Rumors
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Master Trials DLC  
**How to start:** Start by heading over to the Woodland Stable at the southeast corner of the Great Hyrule Forest region near Mirro Shaz Shrine. Inside the stable, there is an open book with the clues.
**Walkthrough:** Enter the Lost Woods through the entrance in the southeast, north of Woodland Tower. Follow the torches as you would normally until you reach the area with the final two torches. Take note of the embers and which way the wind blows them which is the direction you will need to run towards. In order to get the Korok Mask you just need to keep running in the same direction from the two torches, even when the wind changes. This will lead you to a tree where you can use Magnesis to pull out the special chest with the Korok Mask inside.
**Reward:** Korok Mask

locations.title: EX Teleportation Rumors!
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Master Trials DLC  
**How to start:** Head to South Akkala Stable near Ze Kasho Shrine, northwest of Akkala Tower and look for an open book on the table inside the stable.  
**Walkthrough:** Head to the Tu Ka'loh Shrine. Inside, run to the far end of the room towards the back wall to find the treasure chest containing the Travel Medallion.
**Reward:** Travel Medallion

locations.title: EX Treasure: Ancient Mask
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Master Trials DLC

**How to start:** Warp to the Great Plateau Tower and paraglide east to Outpost Ruins. Head for the southernmost walls.

**Walkthrough:** Lake Kolomo is found north of the Great Plateau Tower in the Central Hyrule Region.  Nearby are the Kolomo Garrsion Ruins on the southeast edge of Lake Kolomo. Outside the walls is a small heap of rubble. Use Magnesis to pull the treasure chest out of the ground containing Majora's Mask.

**Reward:** Majora's Mask

locations.title: EX Treasure: Fairy Clothes
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Master Trials DLC  

**How to start:** Warp to the Great Plateau Tower and paraglide east to Outpost Ruins. Head for the southern most walls.

**Walkthrough:** This leads Link to Exchange Ruins, southeast of Kaam Ya'tak Shrine and northwest of Lake Kolomo. Once you get there, look for a pile of rubble on the east side of the ruins and use Magnesis to dredge up the treasure chest. Inside you'll find Tingle's Hood.

The second clue leads Link to Castle Town Prison, an island west of Hyrule Castle and north of Moat Bridge. Look around the path with several burned wooden posts and use Magnesis to pull out a treasure chest from the rubble to get the Tingle's Shirt.

The third clue leads Link to Mabe Village Ruins, west of the Ranch Ruins and east of the Central Tower. Once at the ruins, look for the rusted remains of a Guardian and use Magnesis to lift the treasure chest from under it. Inside are the nice and tight Tingle's Tights.

**Reward:** Tingle's Hood, Tingle's Shirt, Tingle's Tights

locations.title: EX Treasure: Twilight Relic
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Master Trials DLC  

**How to start:** Warp to the Great Plateau Tower and paraglide east to Outpost Ruins. Head for the southern most walls.

**Walkthrough:** This clue leads Link to Sage Temple Ruins, west of Giant's Forest and east of Satori Mountain in northwest Central Hyrule. Travel to the Central Hyrule Tower and you'll be able to glide northwest, but watch out for Guardians at the foot of the tower.

Once there, head over to the western most building where you'll find a pile of rubble in the shallow water. Beside the sword and shield is a treasure chest stuck in the ground. Use Magnesis to squeeze the chest out, then open it to find the fabled Midna's Helmet. 

**Reward:** Midna's Helmet

locations.title: EX Treasure: Phantasma
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Master Trials DLC  

**How to start:** Warp to the Great Plateau Tower and paraglide east to Outpost Ruins. Head for the southern most walls.  

**Walkthrough:** This clue leads Link to the Coliseum Ruins, north of the Great Plateau and south of the Mount Daphnes. You'll need to enter and defeat (or avoid) the Lynel inside, then look along the northwest walls of the ground floor and use Magnesis on the buried chest to find the Phantom Helmet.

You'll find the next item in the Sacred Ground Ruins, south of Hyrule Castle Town Ruins and northwest of Mabe Village Ruins. Once at the ruins, check the middle ring of water along the southeast side to use Magnesis to pull the chest out of the rubble. Inside you'll find the Phantom Armor.

The last item is in the Hyrule Garrison Ruins, east of Mount Daphnes and north of Windvane Meadow. Look for a rusted Guardian on the eastern edge of the ruins and use Magnesis on the chest below it to find the Phantom Greaves.

**Reward:** Phantom Helmet, Phantom Armor, Phantom Greaves

locations.title: Trial of the Sword
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Master Trials DLC  
**How to start:** The Trial of the Sword is hidden inside the Lost Woods, in the very pedestal that the Master Sword sleeps in. This means you can only take on the trial when you have successfully found and obtained the Master Sword.
**Walkthrough:** ??  
**Reward:** ??

locations.title: The Old Man's Diary
locations.description:
**Location:** In the ramshackled house.  
**Contents:**  
_Initial:_  On this desolate plateau, the only pleasure that brings me comfort is cooking. And today, I outdid myself! Truly, I created the perfect dish. I call it... spicy meat and seafood fry. This recipe not only restores health, but it also keeps me warm, even when traveling in the snowy mountains. With this dish on my side, I no longer have need of that itchy warm doublet.  
I do not know how I allowed this to happen, but it seems I forgot to write down a very important recipe. I know it contained raw meat and spicy peppers. However... I simply cannot remember what else I used! My age is catching up to me.  
Sadly, on this lonely plateau, I have only my own knowledge and memory to rely on. Still... If I did find someone who knew the missing ingredient, I would happily reward them with my warm doublet. However, it seems unlikely that such a miraculous wish will ever be fulfilled.

_After showing the Old Man some Spicy Meat and Seafood Fry (Raw Meat, Spicy Pepper, Hyrule Bass)_: To my surprise and delight, I did happen upon someone who was able to re-create my spicy meat and seafood fry. I gave him my warm doublet, and I was happy to do so. He is a fine young man with great potential, that one.  
Ah, and I will now write down this perfect recipe so that I will never forget it. Place some raw meat, spicy pepper, and hyrule bass in a pot, and then turn up the heat. Voilà!  
Eating this dish allows you to walk the snowy mountains with ease, though I did forget there's a time limit on the effect. It is too bad I already gave away that warm doublet, which keeps you warm no matter how long you wear it.

_After completing [The Isolated Plateau](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248304):_ Link... Bit by bit, you may come to realize who I am. I am sorry for not revealing my true identity to you sooner. The truth is, after you awoke from your long Slumber of Restoration, I did not know how to tell you all there was to say.  
Perhaps deceiving you was not the right thing to do. Still...you must admit I put on a great performance! But all joking aside...what I ask of you is of the utmost importance, dear hero. I implore you, with all my heart... defeat Calamity Ganon and save my precious daughter, Zelda. I understand this is no simple task I am asking of you, but I know beyond a shadow of a doubt that you can do it. I do not doubt it for a moment. I see courage in your eyes, just as I did 100 years ago. I believe in you, Link.

locations.title: Super Rumor Mill V4
locations.description:
**Location:** On a table, inside the stable.  
**Contents:**
From the moment I wake to the moment I sleep, my mind is full of rumors. Even my dreams are gossipy! Traysi here!  
You fine folks keep up with dream rumors too, don't you?  
Well, this one's so good it might as well be a dream. Listen up, history buffs!  
This tidbit is about the brave soldiers who were tragically wiped out during the Great Calamity.  
The royal guards who protected the royal family!  
Amongst Hyrule's soldiers, only the best of the best had the honor of guarding the royal family.  
Apparently, the equipment they wore can still be found somewhere in Hyrule Castle.  
They say a former maid spoke of treasure [near the Dining Hall](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244522), in [the Guards' Chamber](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244521), and on [the second floor](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=244520).  
I do hope one day Hyrule Castle is restored to its former glory, complete with royal guards.  
Hmm... I wonder when a royal guard in shining armor will come sweep me off MY feet...  
Traysi's Recommendation: ★★★★★ [5 stars]
